1.description: Bruenor slashes at the closest enemy with his axe.
1.name: Slice

2.description: Bruenor delivers a devastating blow to the closest enemy.
2.long_description: Bruenor delivers a devastating blow to a single enemy using his shield and axe.
2.name: Bash

3.description: A flash of light streaks towards the closest enemy.
3.name: Guiding Bolt

4.description: Celeste calls forth a pillar of flame centered on a random enemy.
4.long_description: Celeste prays for the power of Selûne to call forth a pillar of flame on a random enemy, burning all nearby enemies as well. Simultaneously, a pillar of light heals living party members to full health.
4.name: Flame Strike

5.description: Nayeli cleaves all targets near the closest enemy.
5.name: Swing

6.description: Nayeli deals massive damage to a random enemy and stuns all enemies.
6.long_description: Nayeli leaps to a random enemy, dealing massive damage and stunning all enemies.
6.name: Banishing Smite

7.description: Jarlaxle attacks the furthest enemy. If it dies, he keeps on attacking, halving his damage each time.
7.name: Rapier

8.description: Jarlaxle summons the Bregan D'aerthe to attack enemies in the formation from afar with cannon fire.
8.long_description: Jarlaxle summons the Bregan D'aerthe to attack enemies in the formation from afar with cannon fire.
8.name: Raiding Party

9.description: Calliope lets loose a string of insulting melodies, hitting the two closest enemies.
9.name: Vicious Mockery

10.description: Calliope lets loose a piercing crossbow bolt and shields all members of the party.
10.long_description: Calliope points her lute at a random enemy and lets loose a hidden crossbow bolt. It tears through all enemies in a line. After attacking, she engages her damage shield on all members of your party.
10.name: Impale

11.description: Asharra lets loose a barrage of missiles, hitting random targets.
11.name: Magic Missile

12.description: Asharra pushes back all enemies and casts a massive Fireball on a random one.
12.long_description: Asharra leaps into the air, flapping her wings and pushing all enemies away from the party. Hovering there, she summons a massive fireball that hits a random enemy and all other enemies within a small radius.
12.name: Fireball

13.description: Minsc cleaves all targets near the closest enemy.
13.name: Cleave

14.description: Minsc and Boo attack together, dealing massive cleaving damage.
14.long_description: Minsc swings his greatsword in a massive circle centered on the front-most enemy while Boo leaps about causing up to 5 random enemies to take additional damage for the next 30 seconds.
14.name: Go for the Eyes!

15.description: Blue cracking lightning hits the closest enemy.
15.name: Witch Bolt

16.description: Delina's eyes begin to glow as she loses herself in her magic.
16.long_description: Delina's eyes begin to glow as she loses herself in her magic, attacking faster and causing her Surge of Power ability to not reset for 15 seconds.
16.name: Controlled Chaos

17.description: A beam of green crackling energy streaks towards a random enemy.
17.name: Eldritch Blast

18.description: A sphere of negative energy ripples out from a random enemy.
18.long_description: A sphere of negative energy ripples out from a random enemy, causing that enemy and all other enemies near it to take heavy damage.
18.name: Circle of Death

19.description: Tyril smacks the closest enemy with his staff.
19.name: Shillelagh

20.description: Tyril hits a line of enemies with a brilliant and deadly beam of light.
20.long_description: A beam of brilliant light flashes out from Tyril's off-hand and hits all enemies in a line, targetting a random enemy.
20.name: Sunbeam

23.description: Jamilah attacks the closest enemy. If more enemies are nearby, she attacks up to 2 of them and reduces her base and ultimate c/ds by 2 secs.
23.name: Frenzy

24.description: Jamilah leaps quickly from enemy to enemy, swinging her greatsword.
24.long_description: Jamilah leaps quickly from enemy to enemy, swinging her greatsword through them in a feat of strength and agility. She hits 6 times in total.
24.name: Rage!

25.description: Arkhan attacks the closest enemy with the fury of Tiamat.
25.name: Tiamat's Fury

26.description: Arkhan breaths deadly dragon fire on a cone of enemies.
26.long_description: Arkhan rushes forward to the nearest enemy and breaths dragon fire on them and all enemies in a large cone.
26.name: Flame Breath

27.description: Tyril bites the nearest enemies and gains a massive damage shield.
27.long_description: Tyril leaps to the nearest enemies, biting them with his huge jaws and, based on the enemies hit/killed, gains a damage shield that slowly fades over time.
27.name: Shielding Bite

28.description: Chango enters the battle, dealing enormous damage to a random enemy and all nearby enemies.
28.long_description: Arkhan's pet manticore, Chango, enters the battle, leaping to a random enemy and dealing enormous damage to it and all nearby foes.
28.name: Chango Unchained

32.description: Tyril claws at the nearest enemy.
32.name: Maul

39.description: Hitch throws a number of daggers and then stabs the nearest target in the face.
39.name: Facestab

40.description: Hitch stabs the nearest target in the face. Ouch!
40.name: Facestab

41.description: Hitch disappears into the shadows and brutally backstabs the five furthest enemies.
41.long_description: Hitch disappears into the shadows and reappears behind the furthest enemy, whom he stabs. He then repeats this for the next four furthest enemies, if applicable.
41.name: Shadow Attack

42.description: Stoki leaps out and attacks random enemies with her fists.
42.name: Flurry of Blows

43.description: Stoki leaps around the screen attacking random enemies and causing damage over time.
43.long_description: Stoki leaps out and attacks five random enemies with extremely powerful palm thrusts. Over the next 10 seconds, all affected enemies take massive damage over time.
43.name: Quivering Palm

46.description: Krond leaps out and attacks the front-most target with his bonded warhammer.
46.name: Orcish Smash

47.description: Krond leaps out and attacks the front-most target with his bonded warhammer and then casts Thunderclap, damaging all nearby enemies.
47.name: War Magic

48.description: Krond leaps out and attacks the front-most target with his bonded warhammer and then casts Shocking Grasp, adding additional damage.
48.name: War Magic

49.description: Krond leaps out and attacks the front-most target with his bonded warhammer and then casts Fire Bolt, damaging several random enemies.
49.name: War Magic

50.description: Krond teleports to a random enemy and causes massive area damage.
50.long_description: Krond throws down his warhammer and leaps up into the air, teleporting to a random enemy and causing massive area damage by slamming down to the ground and casting Shatter when he appears.
50.name: Arcane Charge

52.description: Part 2 of Kronds Attack - Shocking Grasp
52.name: Krond's Shocking Grasp

53.description: Part 2 of Kronds Attack - Fire Bolt
53.name: Krond's Fire Bolt

57.description: Gromma Nander, moving faster than you would expect for an 80 year old Tortle, stabs the closest enemy with her spear.
57.name: Slow and Steady

58.description: Gromma draws upon her Druid training to fling an Acid Arrow on the nearest enemy.
58.name: Melf's Acid Arrow

59.description: Gromma summons a wall of stone, knocking enemies back and blocking their movement.
59.long_description: A wall of stone bursts up out of the ground under a random enemy. The targeted enemy and any enemies in the column that the wall appears in take damage and are knocked backwards. The wall lasts for 15 seconds, and for that time enemies cannot pass it.
59.name: Wall Of Stone

60.description: Dhadius tosses a Chromatic orb with a random element at the nearest enemy.
60.name: Chromatic Orb

61.description: Dhadius summons a storm of Magic Missiles.
61.long_description: Dhadius summons a storm of Magic Missiles - one for every enemy, plus a few extras for good measure.
61.name: Magic Missile Barrage

63.description: Drizzt attacks the nearest enemy with his scimitar Icingdeath.
63.name: Dual Wield (Icingdeath)

64.description: Drizzt attacks the nearest enemy with his scimitar Twinkle.
64.name: Dual Wield (Twinkle)

65.description: Drizzt attacks the nearest enemy with both of his scimitars, Icingdeath and Twinkle.
65.name: Dual Wield (Twin Scimitars)

66.description: Drizzt attacks in a whirl of steel, continuing his attack until his sharpened blades don't kill an enemy in one hit.
66.long_description: Drizzt attacks in a whirl of steel, continuing his attack until his sharpened blades don't kill an enemy in one hit.
66.name: Whirl of Steel

67.description: Barrowin smashes the nearest enemy with her mighty warhammer.
67.name: Mighty Hammer

68.description: Barrowin infuses herself with holy energy, shielding and buffing her attack cooldown.
68.long_description: Barrowin infuses herself with holy energy, shielding allies in her column and decreasing her own attack cooldown by 2 seconds.
68.name: Holy Weapon

69.description: Drizzt's companion, Guenhwyvar, attacks the two nearest enemies, leaving them with a long bleed effect.
69.name: Guenhwyvar Attack

71.description: Regis reluctantly stabs the nearest enemy with his dagger.
71.name: Reluctant Stab

72.description: Regis attacks using the power of his ruby pendant.
72.long_description: Regis holds up his ruby pendant, mesmerizing all enemies and slowing them for 15 seconds. Enemies take 200% additional damage while slowed. He also damages all enemies.
72.name: Ruby Brilliance

73.description: Devourer hits a Champion, transports them to their belly and eats them
73.long_description: Devourer hits a Champion, transports them to their belly and eats them
73.name: Devourer Blast

74.description: Birdsong leaps out with a cat's grace and attacks the nearest enemies with her sword.
74.name: Flashing Blades

75.description: Birdsong leaps from enemy to enemy, dealing damage and stunning them.
75.long_description: Birdsong leaps from enemy to enemy 5 times, dealing damage and stunning them for 5 seconds. When she's done, her normal attack cooldown is lowered by 50% for 15 seconds.
75.name: Cat's Agility

78.name: Enemy Ranged Web Spit NOT USED?

82.description: Zorbu fires a bolt from his massive crossbow at a random enemy, dealing damage to all.
82.name: Massive Bolt

83.description: Zorbu winds up a small mechanical squirrel and sends it skittering towards a random enemy.
83.long_description: Zorbu winds up a small mechanical squirrel and sends it skittering towards a random enemy. When it reaches them, it detonates the hidden vial of Alchemist's fire inside, and does AOE damage to all nearby enemies.
83.name: Mechanical Squirrel

87.description: Strix throws a fireball at a random enemy, dealing a small amount of aoe damage.
87.name: Fireball

88.description: Strix's staff polymorphs into a random object, changing the way she attacks for a brief period.
88.long_description: Strix's staff polymorphs into a pie plate, an owlbear plushy, or a flying broom, and changes her base attack for a brief period of time.
88.name: Polymorph Staff

92.description: Strix attacks with her Flame Blade pie plate, hitting a nearby enemy as well
92.long_description: Strix attacks with her Flame Blade pie plate dealing 5x the damage of her regular attacking, and hitting a nearby enemy with that same damage as well
92.name: Pie Plate Punch

93.description: Waffles attacks in Strix's stead, become more enraged with each attack
93.long_description: Strix's Owlbear companion, Waffles, attacks in her stead. Waffles starts doing 3x Strix's damage, and does 2x the damage each attack for 5 attacks.
93.name: Waffles Whack

95.description: Strix throws a fireball at a random enemy, dealing a small amount of aoe damage.
95.name: Flying Fireball

97.description: Nrakk attacks the nearest enemy with his Kensei Weapon.
97.name: Naginata

98.description: Nrakk channels Ki into his Naginata, increasing the damage dealt by all of his attacks.
98.long_description: Nrakk channels Ki into his Naginata, increasing the damage dealt by all of his attacks by $(nrakk_ult_buffed 200)% for the next 30 seconds.
98.name: Sharpen the Blade

99.description: Catti-brie shoots the farthest enemy with her bow
99.name: Long Shot

100.description: Catti-Brie shoots six arrows at once from her bow, making each enemy hit more vulnerable for 30 seconds.
100.long_description: Catti-Brie shoots six arrows at once from her bow. Each enemy hit by her arrows can be crit by all Champions using Catti-brie's crit chance and damage bonus for 30 seconds.
100.name: Empty the Quiver

102.description: Evelyn smashes the front-most enemy with her enormous battleaxe. Every third attack, she cleaves all nearby enemies as well.
102.name: Mighty Axe

103.description: Evelyn summons her Celestial Pegasus and dashes across the battlefield.
103.long_description: Evelyn summons her Celestial Pegasus and dashes across the battlefield, damaging all enemies in a line for massive damage and briefly stunning all damaged enemies.
103.name: Find Steed

107.description: Binwin attacks the front-most enemy with his twin axes, Rook and Ruin.
107.name: Twin Axes

108.description: Binwin hops onto a sturdy wooden barrel and rides toward a single enemy, creating a path of destruction in his wake.
108.long_description: Binwin hops onto a sturdy wooden barrel and rides toward a single enemy, dealing damage along the way. When he reaches the targeted enemy, the barrel explodes, dealing AOE damage and slowing all affected enemies.
108.name: Barrel Roll

117.description: Deekin takes aim with his crossbow and fires at a random enemy.
117.name: Building Suspense

118.description: Deekin shouts DOOM as loudly as he can, dealing massive damage and buffing Story of Doom.
118.long_description: Deekin shouts DOOM as loud as he can, dealing massive damage and setting Story of Doom to max stacks for 30 seconds.
118.name: DOOOOOOOM!

123.description: Xander backstabs a random opponent. Unfortunately, he doesn't always exactly hit them.
123.name: Acrobatic Backstab

124.description: Xander summons a friendly neighborhood stone giant.
124.long_description: Xander uses his miniature statue to summon one of Waterdeep's giant walking statues. A giant stone foot smashes all enemies from above, dealing massive damage.
124.name: Friends in High Places

125.description: Azaka leaps into the air and strikes a random enemy; 33% cleave chance
125.name: Pick Them Off

126.description: Azaka dons her Mask of the Beast, summoning 2 tigers to her side for 30 seconds, the tigers attack every 5 seconds
126.long_description: Azaka dons her Mask of the Beast, summoning 2 tigers to her side that attack every 5 seconds. The tigers stay for 30 seconds. If Azaka specs with Lycanthrope Forever the tiger attacks count towards her weretiger transformation, and her weretiger cooldown is paused during her Ultimate. If she specs with Resist the Curse, the tigers' attacks cause enemies to drop gold even if they aren't killed.
126.name: Mask of the Beast

128.description: Ishi attacks the front-most enemy a quarter second faster than anyone else.
128.long_description: Ishi attacks the front-most enemy. She always attacks 0.25 seconds faster than the fastest member of the formation, or every 6 seconds if she is the only Champion
128.name: Quick Strike

129.description: For $ishi_ult_time seconds, Ishi's damage is increased by 100% for each non-human in the formation (multiplicative)
129.long_description: For $ishi_ult_time seconds, Ishi's damage is increased by 100% for each non-human in the formation (multiplicative)
129.name: Confidence Boost

134.description: Wulfgar smashes the nearest group of enemies with a $stun_chance% chance to stun them for $stun_time seconds.
134.name: Barbarian Smash

135.description: Shouting the name of his deity, Wulfgar tosses his warhammer, Aegis-fang, at the most distant enemy, dealing damage to and stunning all enemies in a line for 10 seconds.
135.long_description: Shouting the name of his deity, Wulfgar tosses his warhammer, Aegis-fang, at the most distant enemy, dealing damage to and stunning all enemies in a line for 10 seconds.
135.name: Tempus!

137.description: Farideh creates $attack_num_targets rays of fire and hurls them at random enemies.
137.name: Scorching Ray

138.description: Farideh taps into her infernal bloodline, pushing away, slowing, and damaging nearby enemies.
138.long_description: Farideh taps into her infernal bloodline, pushing away and slowing all enemies, then damaging a random enemy every second, for 15 seconds.
138.name: Infernal Aspect

139.description: Donaar targets a random enemy, casting a random Command on them and doing a small amount of psychic damage
139.long_description: Hold: stuns enemy for $(attack_indexed_effect_amount 0)s; Flee: Enemy pushed back, taking $(attack_indexed_effect_amount 1)% more damage for 10s; Fear: Enemy has $(attack_indexed_effect_amount 2)% chance attacks miss for 5s; Drop: Enemy drops $(attack_indexed_effect_amount 3)% bonus gold on death
139.name: Command

140.description: Donaar attacks the nearest enemies with his comically oversized sword, then vomits acid.
140.long_description: Donaar attacks the nearest enemies with his comically oversized sword, then vomits acid in a puddle which deals damage to enemies who walk through it.
140.name: Acid Vomit

141.description: Vlahnya damages a random enemy with her Mage Hand.
141.name: Mage Hand

142.description: Vlahnya leaps into the fray and instantly teleports up to 10 non-boss enemies away.
142.long_description: Vlahnya leaps into the fray and instantly teleports up to 10 non-boss enemies away, permanently removing them from combat. Also maxes out all stacks of Enthralling Performance.
142.name: Plane Shift

144.description: Arkhan cleaves the closest enemies with the fury of Tiamat.
144.name: Tiamat's Cleaving Fury

145.description: Arkhan breaths a cone of Tiamat's fury (fire) on nearby enemies.
145.name: Tiamat's Flame Fury

153.description: Warden leaps to a random enemy and attacks them with their armblade.
153.name: Hex Weapon Armblade

154.description: Warden opens a rift to the void, pulling all enemies to one spot on the screen.
154.long_description: Warden opens a rift to the void, damaging and momentarily stunning all enemies and pulling them to a position slightly in front of the formation.
154.name: Hunger of Hadar

155.description: Nerys cleaves all targets near the closest enemy.
155.name: Dash and Slash

156.description: Nerys blasts all enemies, reducing their damage and increasing party damage.
156.long_description: Nerys leaps into the field, unleashing a halo of divine energy. It hits all enemies and decreases their damage done by 50% while increasing the damage the party does by 300%. These effects last 30 seconds.
156.name: Tip the Scales

169.description: K'thriss telepathically whispers a discordant melody that damages and slows a random enemy.
169.name: Dissonant Whispers

170.description: K'thriss summons a horde of tentacles that damage and slow all enemies.
170.long_description: K'thriss summons a horde of tentacles across the battlefield that damage and slow all enemies.
170.name: Tentacular Spectacular

171.description: Simon attacks with a poisoned dart. Paultin attacks too, sometimes.
171.name: Poison Dart

172.description: Paultin swings the Sunsword, creating a shockwave that deals massive damage to all enemies.
172.long_description: Paultin swings the Sunsword, dealing massive damage to all enemies. The damage is increased by the current enemy enrage multiplier.
172.name: Thunderwave

181.description: Black Viper attacks a random enemy with her daggers.
181.name: En Garde

182.description: Black Viper throws down a massive smokescreen, hindering enemies and helping herself.
182.long_description: Black Viper creates a smokescreen, reducing damage done to the formation and causing all of her attacks to be Sneak Attacks.
182.name: Smokescreen

185.description: Rosie appears behind a random enemy and strikes them with her fists.
185.name: Shadow Step

186.description: Rosie roots all enemies and darts around, striking up to 10, then deflects all missiles for a time.
186.long_description: Rosie roots all enemies on the screen and darts around striking up to 10 for massive damage, then deflects all ranged and magic attacks for 15 seconds.
186.name: Grammamancy

187.description: Rosie darts towards a random enemy and swings her staff, dealing AoE damage.
187.name: Shadow Arts

188.description: Aila attacks the nearest enemy with her warhammer, the Howling Gale, knocking them back slightly.
188.name: The Howling Gale

189.description: Aila unleashes lightning across all her enemies, damaging and stunning all of them.
189.long_description: Aila unleashes lightning across all enemies, damaging and stunning them for 5 seconds. Deals 10% more damage for each Electrified enemy on the screen.
189.name: Storm Herald

190.description: A small blast of fire hits a single random enemy
190.name: Wild Magic - Fire Bolt

191.description: A line of lightning shoots towards a random enemy, damaging all enemies in a line
191.name: Wild Magic - Lightning Bolt

192.description: A storm of ice rains from above, hitting all enemies in a small radius
192.name: Wild Magic - Ice Storm

198.description: Spurt tosses a wasp nest at a random enemy, dealing damage.
198.name: Wasp Nest

199.description: Spurt tosses a wasp nest at a stalking giant, and then is immediately killed.
199.long_description: Spurt tosses a wasp nest at a stalking giant, and then is immediately killed by a giant hammer, which damages all Enemies on screen. Spurt then comes back as a spirit, increasing the effects of his abilities until he revives.
199.name: You Dead!

201.description: Spurt doesn't attack, but instead buffs his abilities Centipede Net, Wa-spiration, and Pack Tactics
201.long_description: Spurt doesn't attack, but instead buffs his abilities Centipede Net, Waspiration, and Pack Tactics
201.name: Spurt's Spirit

207.description: Qillek attacks the frontmost monsters with a flurry of feathers.
207.name: Feather Flurry

208.description: Qillek rains purple feathers from above, calming all attacking monsters.
208.long_description: Qillek rains purple feathers from above, calming all attacking monsters and reducing their attack and enrage speeds to 1/3rd for the next 30 seconds.
208.name: Calm Emotions

212.description: Korth charges out and attacks the nearest enemy with his samurai sword.
212.name: Samurai Slice

213.description: Korth leaps to the nearest enemy and ferociously bites them.
213.long_description: Korth leaps to the nearest enemy and ferociously bites them, causing massive damage and a bleed for 4x the base damage over 10 sec.
213.name: Hungry Jaws

214.description: Walnut savagely attacks the nearest enemy with her scimitar.
214.name: Wicked Scimitar

215.description: Wolfnut savagely attacks the nearest enemy, dealing damage to other enemies near it as well.
215.name: Ferocious Bite

216.description: Walnut summons a swarm of lovable forest friends to attack all enemies.
216.long_description: Walnut summons a swarm of lovable forest friends to attack all enemies. Each enemy killed heals the party by 10% of their max health. If no enemies are killed, the formation gains a temporary hit point shield equal to 100% of their max health.
216.name: Forest Friends

217.description: The raccoon throws trash that increases base attack cooldown
217.long_description: The raccoon throws trash that increases base attack cooldown
217.name: Throw Trash

218.description: A fireblast from a spined devil
218.long_description: A spined devil shoots a fireblast at a random target and hits all adjacent heroes
218.name: Spined Devil Fireblast

219.description: Shandie fires an arrow at a random enemy.
219.name: Shortbow Expert

220.description: Shandie fires an explosive arrow at the closest enemy.
220.name: Explosive Arrow

221.description: Shandie throws smoke grenades and caltrops onto the battlefield, causing enemies to bleed and miss 50% of their attacks for 10 seconds.
221.long_description: Shandie bends the odds in the party's favor, throwing smoke grenades and caltrops onto the battlefield, causing enemies to take the ultimate's full damage over 10 seconds and having a 50% chance to miss their attacks during that time.
221.name: Survivalist

222.description: Jim attacks random enemies with his own brand of magic missiles.
222.name: Jim's Magic Missile

223.description: Jim attacks all enemies with a showy shower of sparks.
223.long_description: Jim attacks all enemies with a showy shower of sparks. You can't miss it!
223.name: Jim's Magical Maelstrom

224.description: Jim attacks a random enemy with his Wand of Wonder, applying a random effect.
224.long_description: Jim attacks a random enemy with his Wand of Wonder, applying a random effect.
224.name: Wand of Wonder

225.description: Jim attacks random enemies with his own brand of magic missiles.
225.name: Jim's Magic Missile

226.description: Turiel points at a random enemy and flame-like radiance strikes them from above.
226.name: Sacred Flame

227.description: Turiel pushes back enemies and slowly increases party damage for 30 seconds as long as no one in the party is attacked.
227.long_description: Turiel removes his mask and becomes enveloped in a pillar of light. All enemies are pushed back and the party's damage slowly increases over 30 seconds. If a Champion gets attacked, this buff is reduced. The ultimate will end early if the party gets hit by too many attacks. During this time Turiel is immobile and doesn't attack.
227.name: Beacon of Light

228.description: Pwent headbutts a random enemy, using his spiked armour to inflict a bleed effect.
228.name: Spiked Hug

229.description: Pwent dashes quickly around the area rounding up all available enemies, and then stuns, damages, and inflicts a bleed effect on them.
229.long_description: Pwent dashes quickly around the area rounding up all available enemies, and then stuns, damages, and inflicts a bleed effect on them.
229.name: Round 'Em Up!

231.description: Avren tosses three spectral shards at random enemies. One does damage, one stuns, and one is fake and only briefly staggers the enemy.
231.name: Spectral Shards

232.description: Avren jumps out to a random enemy and kicks them with his enlarged foot, knocking them back.
232.name: Kick

233.description: Avren casts Reduce on all his enemies and Enlarge on himself, then begins kicking the teenie-tiny enemies around.
233.long_description: Avren casts Reduce on all enemies on the screen, dealing some damage and reducing their size by half and their damage done by 50% for 15 seconds. He also casts Enlarge on himself for the duration, and during that time his base attack changes from Spectral Shards to Kick.
233.name: Insignificance

241.description: Sentry attacks the nearest enemy with her Battleaxe, which explodes with radiant light.
241.name: Divine Strike

242.description: Sentry charges into battle atop a transformed echo, dealing damage over time with her flame lance.
242.long_description: Sentry charges into battle atop a transformed echo, dealing damage over time with her flame lance.
242.name: Flame Lance

250.description: Krull attacks a random enemy with his Maul.
250.name: Krull's Maul

251.description: Krull summons four corrupted ghouls that rush towards the nearest enemies and explode.
251.long_description: Krull summons four corrupted ghouls that rush towards the nearest enemies and explode, damaging all nearby enemies and leaving behind pools of necrotic goo that last for 30 seconds.
251.name: Corrupted Ghouls

254.description: Krull attacks a random enemy with his Maul. Adding a Plague if possible, or adding 2 stacks to each of their Plagues.
254.name: Necrotic Touch

255.description: Artemis attacks the nearest enemy with his Vampiric Dagger.
255.name: Vampiric Dagger

256.description: Artemis shows off his martial prowess, leaping out to attack whenever someone else does.
256.long_description: For 30 seconds, Artemis concentrates on showing off his martial prowess, increasing his base damage by 300% for each DPS Champion in the formation (including himself), stacking multiplicatively. Artemis' base attack cooldown also completes whenever another DPS Champion attacks.
256.name: One Upped

260.description: Dragonbait attacks the closest enemy with his sword, hitting all nearby enemies with a small cleave.
260.name: Slice Through

261.description: Dragonbait jumps out and strikes with his Holy Avenger, dealing damage to all enemies on screen and clearing any stun/charm effects on Champions.
261.long_description: Dragonbait jumps out and strikes with his Holy Avenger, dealing damage to all enemies on screen and immediately clearing any stun/charm effects on Champions. Any Fiends or Undead left alive are marked with an overlay of the Holy Avenger. Champions who attack marked enemies deal 400% additional damage.
261.name: Holy Avenger

262.description: Môrgæn shoots an arrow at a random target, then quickly follows up with a second arrow.
262.long_description: Môrgæn shoots an arrow at a random target, then quickly follows up with a second arrow. This arrow always targets the same enemy, even if that enemy is killed by the first arrow.
262.name: Rapid Shot

263.description: Môrgæn shoots a customized arrow from her quiver, with one of 3 random effects.
263.long_description: Môrgæn pulls a customized arrow from her quiver at random, and fires this more powerful arrow towards a random enemy.
263.name: Customized Arrow

264.description: Môrgæn shoots a customized arrow from her quiver, with one of 3 random effects.
264.long_description: Môrgæn pulls a customized arrow from her quiver at random, and fires this more powerful arrow towards a random enemy.
264.name: Customized Arrow

265.description: Môrgæn shoots a customized arrow from her quiver, with one of 3 random effects.
265.long_description: Môrgæn pulls a customized arrow from her quiver at random, and fires this more powerful arrow towards a random enemy.
265.name: Customized Arrow

266.description: Havilar cleaves the closest enemy with her Glaive, hitting all nearby enemies.
266.name: Glaive Thrust

267.description: Each summoned Imp attacks a random enemy with a fireball, dealing a large amount of AOE damage.
267.name: Fire of Asmodeus

268.description: Mot and another imp are summoned. The Imps attack with Fire of Asmodeus.
268.long_description: Mot and another imp (Dembo, Olla, or Bosh) are summoned. The Imps attack with Fire of Asmodeus, dealing AoE damage. Havilar's ultimate attack is replaced with Heroic Sacrifice. The Imps stay active until Heroic Sacrifice is used.
268.name: Summon Imps

269.description: An imp flings itself at the nearest enemy and explodes, dealing massive damage in a large area and slowing all affected enemies.
269.long_description: The Imp that isn't Mot flings itself at the nearest enemy and explodes, dealing massive damage in a large area and slowing all affected enemies. As soon as this ultimate is used, Havilar's ultimate attack reverts to Summon Imps with a short cooldown.
269.name: Heroic Sacrifice

271.description: Sisaspia unleashes a wave of necrotic energy upon a random enemy. Deals additional damage to plants, but no damage to undead/constructs.
271.name: Blight

272.description: Sisaspia causes all of her spores currently affecting her enemies to delve deep into their targets and tear them apart from the inside, dealing massive damage.
272.long_description: Sisaspia causes all of her spores currently affecting her enemies to delve deep into their targets and tear them apart from the inside, dealing massive damage based on the total number of spores in play.
272.name: Fungal Infestation

278.description: Briv cleaves a random enemy with his greatsword. Each enemy hit has a 20% chance of being taunted, switching its target to Briv.
278.long_description: Briv cleaves a random enemy with his greatsword. Each enemy hit has a 20% chance of being taunted, switching its target to Briv.
278.name: Mocking Cleave

279.description: Briv forces all of his remaining Netherese Metal out of his body, damaging enemies that it passes through.
279.long_description: Briv forces all of his remaining Netherese Metal out of his body, shooting it out in an arc in front of him and damaging all enemies that it passes through. He then draws it all back into himself, dealing double damage to enemies that it hits on its way back.
279.name: Netherese Explosion

281.description: Melf leaps out and attacks the nearest enemy with his magic spear. If he has any Minute Meteors active, he fires one at a random enemy as well.
281.long_description: Melf leaps out and attacks the nearest enemy with his magic spear. If he has any Minute Meteors active, he fires one at a random enemy as well.
281.name: Zagyg's Needle

282.description: Melf summons six Minute Meteors that float around him. They are fired when he attacks normally and deal AOE BUD-based damage.
282.long_description: Melf summons six Minute Meteors that float around him. They are fired when he attacks normally and deal AOE BUD-based damage.
282.name: Melf's Minute Meteors

284.description: Krydle attacks a random enemy with his daggers. He also sneaks a smokepowder bomb onto their person, which explodes after 3 seconds.
284.long_description: Krydle attacks a random enemy with his daggers. While doing so, he reverse pick-pockets a smokepowder bomb onto their person, which explodes for extra damage after 3 seconds if the enemy is not killed in the meantime.
284.name: Reverse Pickpocket

285.description: Krydle appears from the shadows behind a random enemy and brutally backstabs it for massive damage.
285.long_description: Krydle appears from the shadows behind a random enemy and brutally backstabs it for massive damage. The damage of this attack is increased by 200% for each Hero of Baldur's Gate in the formation (stacking multiplicatively).
285.name: Distracted Strike

288.description: Jaheira attacks the nearest enemy with her scimitar, briefly rooting them in place with some vines.
288.name: Tangling Scimitar

289.description: Jaheira blankets the area in front of the party with a swarm of insects for 30 seconds, dealing a small amount of damage to all enemies within the swarm every half-second.
289.long_description: Jaheira blankets the area in front of the party with a swarm of insects for 30 seconds, dealing a small amount of damage to all enemies within the swarm every half-second.
289.name: Insect Plague

292.description: Nova leaps out and slices through the nearest enemy with Tiangong.
292.long_description: Nova leaps out and slices through the nearest enemy with Tiangong. If her attack kills the enemy, it drops a monster heart.
292.name: Dissect

293.description: Nova levitates up in the air as Tiangong floats in front of the formation, releasing three waves of blue energy that deal damage to all enemies.
293.long_description: Nova levitates up in the air as Tiangong floats in front of the formation, releasing three waves of blue energy that deal damage to all enemies. The damage is increased by 1% for every 20 monster hearts Nova has collected, stacking additively.
293.name: Activate Tiangong

294.description: A cone of psychic energy that damages all Champions in the front row.
294.name: Mind Blast

297.description: A beam of aquamarine crackling energy streaks towards a random enemy.
297.name: Eldritch Blast

298.description: Freely grabs his sword and launches himself toward an enemy, showering green and red lightning in his wake until he smashes into his opponent for massive damage.
298.long_description: Freely grabs his sword and smashes into his opponent for massive damage. He also applies or refreshes all four Lucky Breaks on that enemy, if it is unlucky enough to survive.
298.name: I Will Not Deafen

302.description: Omin smashes the nearest enemy with his maul.
302.name: Appropriate Intervention

303.description: Omin summons 15 Spirit Guardians which damage a random area every 2 seconds.
303.long_description: Omin summons 15 Spirit Guardians which explode every 2 seconds, damaging all monsters in a large area. The duration of Champion of Tymora is doubled as long as a Spirit remains.
303.name: Spirit Guardian

304.description: Beadle bonks a random enemy with a wand. This unleashes two magic missiles that fly out and hit two other random enemies.
304.name: Magic Wand

305.description: Grimm cleaves through the nearest enemies with his two enormous greatswords.
305.name: Giant's Bane

306.description: Grimm smashes a random enemy and all nearby enemies.
306.long_description: Grimm leaps into the fray, smashing a random enemy and all nearby enemies before leaping back into the formation while Beadle teleports into the shadows to recover.
306.name: Tag Team

307.description: Beadle explodes with arcane magic, damaging and stunning all enemies.
307.long_description: Beadle teleports into the center of the battle and explodes with arcane magic, damaging and stunning all enemies. He then slips quietly back into the formation as Grimm leaps away for a brief rest.
307.name: Tag Team

308.description: Beadle bonks a random enemy with a wand. This unleashes two magic missiles that fly out and hit two other random enemies.
308.name: Magic Wand Missiles

310.description: Ulkoria summons 3 magic missiles and fires them at random targets
310.long_description: Ulkoria summons 3 magic missiles and fires them at random targets (each missile deals 33% of her DPS)
310.name: Magic Missile

311.description: Ulkoria's Shield Guardian steps up behind the formation and casts Lightning Bolt.
311.long_description: Ulkoria's Shield Guardian steps up behind the formation and casts Lightning Bolt once for each stack of Spellcaster School that Ulkoria has. Lightning Bolt targets a random enemy and deals massive damage to all enemies in a line.
311.name: Shield Guardian

312.description: Nat, Jenks, and Squiddy jump onto the screen behind the formation and start tossing things at enemies.
312.long_description: Nat, Jenks, and Squiddy jump onto the screen behind the formation and start tossing things at enemies. Each enemy hit takes damage and is knocked back 20% of the screen, stunned for 5 seconds, and then slowed for 15 seconds. The kids throw a total of 4 items (12 total) over 6 seconds, each targeting a different enemy if possible. If the same enemy is hit multiple times then subsequent hits restart the knockback/stun/slow process.
312.name: Urchin Pranks

322.description: Lazaapz attacks and stuns the nearest enemy. Every fifth attack, she uses her Grappling Fist to pull an enemy closer to her instead.
322.long_description: Lazaapz attacks and stuns the nearest enemy. Every fifth attack, she uses her Grappling Fist to pull an enemy closer to her instead.
322.name: Thunder Gauntlet

323.description: Lazaapz pulls a random enemy closer to her using her Grappling Fist.
323.long_description: Lazaapz pulls a random enemy closer to her using her Grappling Fist.
323.name: Grappling Fist

324.description: Lazaapz immediately regains all of her Power Armor stacks and, for the next 30 seconds, does not expend any stacks when triggering Tiny Bulwark or Lightning Launcher.
324.long_description: (Available at 20 Power Armor stacks or less) Lazaapz immediately regains all of her Power Armor stacks and, for the next 30 sec, doesn't expend any stacks when triggering Power Armor abilities.
324.name: Recharge

325.description: Lazaapz overcharges her Power Armor, preventing it from gaining any more stacks but increasing the effect of Tiny Bulwark and Lightning Launcher by 400% for 30 seconds.
325.long_description: (Available at more than 20 Power Armor stacks) Lazaapz overcharges her Power Armor, preventing it from gaining any more stacks but increasing the effect of Tiny Bulwark and Lightning Launcher by 400% for 30 seconds.
325.name: Overcharge

328.description: Torogar inflames his golden blades and then attacks the nearest enemy.
328.name: Fiery Longswords

329.description: Torogar lowers his head and rushes a random distant enemy, leaving a trail of fire in his wake. The fire deals damage over time to enemies who stand in it.
329.long_description: Torogar lowers his head and rushes a random distant enemy, leaving a trail of fire in his wake. The fire deals damage over time to enemies who stand in it.
329.name: Bull Rush

330.description: Ezmerelda hurls a mote of fire at a random enemy.
330.long_description: Ezmerelda hurls a mote of fire at a random enemy.
330.name: Fire Bolt

331.description: Ezmerelda causes the enemy with the most debuffs active to take 50% more damage for each active debuff on them, stacking multiplicatively.
331.long_description: Ezmerelda causes the enemy with the most debuffs active to take 50% more damage for each active debuff on them, stacking multiplicatively.
331.name: My Signal

332.description: A storm of ice rains from above, hitting all enemies in a small radius
332.name: Enemy Ice Storm

334.description: Penelope jumps out and hits the closest enemy with her quarterstaff, dealing damage and knocking it back slightly.
334.name: Go Away

335.description: A fountain of churned earth and stone erupt under the nearest enemy, dealing area damage in a large radius and creating difficult terrain that lasts for 30 seconds.
335.long_description: A fountain of churned earth and stone erupt under the nearest enemy, dealing area damage in a large radius and creating difficult terrain that slows enemies in it by 50% and lasts for 30 seconds.
335.name: Erupting Earth

343.description: Penelope jumps out and hits the closest enemy with her quarterstaff, dealing damage and knocking it back a lot.
343.name: Go Away

345.description: Penelope jumps out and hits the closest enemy with her quarterstaff, dealing damage and knocking it back slightly and causing a minor Earth Eruption under them.
345.name: Go Away

348.description: Lucius attacks the furthest enemy with Acid Splash, dealing damage.
348.long_description: Lucius attacks the furthest enemy with Acid Splash, dealing damage.
348.name: Acid Splash

349.description: Lucius attacks a random enemy with Ray of Frost, dealing damage to all enemies in it's path
349.long_description: Lucius attacks a random enemy with Ray of Frost, dealing damage to all enemies in it's path
349.name: Ray of Frost

350.description: Baeloth fires a bolt of lightning at a random enemy, which deals damage and arcs up to 4 times dealing, 20% less damage per arc.
350.long_description: Baeloth fires a bolt of lightning at a random enemy, which deals damage and arcs up to 4 times dealing, 20% less damage per arc.
350.name: Chain Lightning

351.description: Lucius attacks with a cone of prismatic energy dealing damage and applying both Arcane Chromat debuffs.
351.long_description: Eight multicoloured rays flash from Lucius' hand in a cone shape. Each enemy in the cone takes damage and receives both Arcane Chromat debuffs.
351.name: Prismatic Spray

352.description: Najim streaks across the field, damaging all enemies, pushing survivors back slightly, and setting Baeloth's excitement stacks to max.
352.long_description: Najim streaks across the field, dealing massive damage to all enemies, pushing ones that survive back slightly, but more importantly increasing Baeloth's excitement stacks to max.
352.name: Now That's An Entrance

353.description: Talin disappears into the shadows and stabs a random enemy with his rapier.
353.long_description: Talin disappears into the shadows and reappears behind a random enemy, stabbing them with his rapier. He then shadowsteps back into the formation.
353.name: Quiet Ambush

354.description: Talin throws a hoop blade in a large looping arc, damaging all enemies it encounters before returning to Talin.
354.long_description: Talin detaches a secondary hoop-shaped blade from his wheelchair's rear wheel and flings it at the farthest enemy. It travels in a large looping arc, damaging all enemies it encounters before returning to Talin.
354.name: Razor Edged Chakram

358.description: The middle kobold shoots a random enemy with a small crossbow.
358.long_description: The middle kobold shoots a random enemy with a small crossbow.
358.name: Crossbow Bolt

359.description: The Kobolds pepper a random enemy with bolts. The effect of Zrang's Teamwork is doubled for 30 seconds.
359.long_description: The Kobolds pepper a random enemy with bolts and Zrang's Teamwork is doubled for 30 seconds.
359.name: Roll Out!

361.description: The Kobolds pepper a random enemy with bolts. Non-boss enemies are stunned and no additional enemies will spawn for 15 seconds.
361.long_description: The Kobolds pepper a random enemy with bolts. Non-boss enemies are stunned and no additional enemies will spawn for 15 seconds.
361.name: Stop!

362.description: The Kobolds pepper a random enemy with bolts. Reduce any active ultimate cooldowns of all Champions in the formation by 25%.
362.long_description: The Kobolds pepper a random enemy with bolts. Reduce any active ultimate cooldowns of all Champions in the formation by 25%.
362.name: Faster!

367.description: Orisha summons rays of fire and hurls them at multiple random targets.
367.long_description: Orisha summons rays of fire and hurls them at multiple random targets.
367.name: Scorching Ray

368.description: Orisha eyes light aglow and two angel wings burst from her back. A wave of divine energy surges across the screen damaging all enemies.
368.long_description: Orisha eyes light aglow and two angel wings burst from her back. A wave of divine energy surges across the screen damaging all enemies.
368.name: Radiant Soul

370.description: Alyndra spikes the mind of a random enemy, damaging them and slowing them by 50% for 3 seconds.
370.long_description: Alyndra reaches into the mind of a random enemy, dealing damage and slowing the enemy by 50% for 3 seconds.
370.name: Mind Spike

371.description: Alyndra foresees the death of all her enemies. For 30 seconds, all enemies take extra damage equal to the total Portent buff being given.
371.long_description: Alyndra foresees the death of all her enemies. For 30 seconds, all enemies take extra damage equal to the total Portent buff being given.
371.name: I Have Foreseen This

373.description: Reya leaps out and slashes at a random enemy, cleaving nearby enemies as well.
373.long_description: Reya leaps out and slashes at a random enemy with the Sword of Zariel, cleaving nearby enemies as well.
373.name: Sword of Zariel

374.description: Lulu puts all enemies to sleep for 10 seconds, then, Reya swings her sword in a massive circle.
374.long_description: Reya launches to the sky, she lands by SLAMMING the Sword of Zariel into the ground with a shockwave summoning Zariel and her friend Lulu. While Reya communes with Zariel, Lulu zips around the board, putting all enemies to sleep for 10 seconds. While the enemies are asleep and Reya remains in her pose, the Champions deal massive damage against them. When the 10 seconds is complete, Reya removes the sword and swings it in a massive circle.
374.name: Avatar of Zariel

376.description: Orkira leaps to a random enemy and attacks with a small AoE cone of fire.
376.long_description: Orkira leaps to a random enemy and attacks with a small AoE cone of fire.
376.name: Burning Hands

377.description: Orkira summons The Phoenix to rain Elemental Fire down upon the battlefield. This deals damage and increases the Elemental Fire stacks.
377.long_description: Orkira flies up over the enemies, grasping The Domain of the Phoenix and uttering a prayer, summoning The Phoenix to rain Elemental Fire down upon the battlefield. This deals damage and increases the Elemental Fire stacks of affected enemies by 1 every 2 seconds for 10 seconds.
377.name: Radiance of the Phoenix

378.description: Orkira leaps to a random enemy and attacks with a medium AoE cone of fire.
378.long_description: Orkira leaps to a random enemy and attacks with a medium AoE cone of fire.
378.name: Burning Hands

393.description: Mehen leaps out and attacks a random enemy, swinging down and then up, scoring a hit each time.
393.long_description: Mehen leaps out and attacks a random enemy, swinging down and then up with a second swing, scoring a hit each time.
393.name: Double Strike

394.description: Mehen breathes a cone of lightning that damages all enemies on the screen. Potentially optimizing Grumpy.
394.long_description: Mehen leaps forward and breaths a cone of lightning that damages all enemies on the screen. If he damages more than 5 enemies then his Grumpy stacks are set to 50 and he gains and loses stacks at 10% of the normal rate for 30 seconds.
394.name: Lightning Breath

395.description: A beam of crackling green shoots towards an enemy, dealing damage.
395.long_description: A beam of crackling green shoots towards an enemy, dealing damage.
395.name: Eldritch Blast

396.description: All enemies are pushed back slightly and then a wall of light appears slightly in front of the formation for 15 seconds.
396.long_description: All enemies are pushed back slightly and then a wall of light appears slightly in front of the formation for 15 seconds. Enemies that pass through the wall of light take damage and gain a brilliant white glow under their feet for 30 seconds. Enemies with this glow have a 75% chance to miss with all attacks.
396.name: Blinding Wall of Light

397.description: A wall of light appears near the right side of the screen.
397.long_description: A wall of light appears near the right side of the screen. Enemies that pass through the wall of light take damage and, if they take at least 1% of their max health, have a 50% chance to be disintegrated and die immediately. Enemies not immediately destroyed gain a white glow under their feet and take 100% more damage for 30 seconds.
397.name: Disintegrating Wall of Light

398.description: Selise attacks the nearest enemy and bashes them, stunning them for 2 seconds.
398.long_description: Bash the enemy before attacking them, stunning them for 2 seconds. This can cause hits- and armor-based enemies to take two hits.
398.name: Sword and Board - Aggressive

399.description: Selise attacks the nearest enemy and takes 25% less damage for 10 seconds.
399.long_description: Take 25% less damage from all attacks for the next 10 seconds.
399.name: Sword and Board - Wall

400.description: Selise attacks the nearest enemy and damages all enemies in a small AOE.
400.long_description: Damage all enemies in a small AOE.
400.name: Sword and Board - Deflect

401.description: Selise attacks the nearest enemy,damages and knocks back all enemies in a small AOE.
401.long_description: Damage and knock back all enemies in a small AOE.
401.name: Sword and Board - Last Resort

402.description: Selise tosses her shield in an arc targeted at the farthest enemy. It deals damage and stuns all enemies hit for 2 seconds.
402.long_description: Selise tosses her shield in an arc targeted at the farthest enemy. It deals damage and stuns all enemies hit for 2 seconds.
402.name: Sword and Board - Shield of Psychomancy

403.description: When used, Selise will switch to Wall stance.
403.long_description: When used, Selise will switch to Wall stance.
403.name: Switch to Wall Stance

404.description: When used, Selise will switch to Deflect stance.
404.long_description: When used, Selise will switch to Deflect stance.
404.name: Switch to Deflect Stance

405.description: When used, Selise will switch to Last Resort stance.
405.long_description: When used, Selise will switch to Last Resort stance.
405.name: Switch to Last Resort Stance

406.description: When used, Selise will switch to Aggressive stance.
406.long_description: When used, Selise will switch to Aggressive stance.
406.name: Switch to Aggressive Stance

407.description: Selise channels the divine power of Tyr and attacks a random enemy with her sword, dealing BUD-based AoE damage and BUD-based chaining lightning damage from the enemy struck to five nearby enemies.
407.long_description: Selise channels the divine power of Tyr and attacks a random enemy with her sword, dealing BUD-based AoE damage and BUD-based chaining lightning damage from the enemy struck to five nearby enemies.
407.name: Thunderous Smite

418.description: Sgt. Knox swings his enormous Battleaxe through the nearest group of enemies.
418.long_description: Sgt. Knox swings his enormous Battleaxe through the nearest group of enemies.
418.name: Battleaxe

419.description: Sgt. Knox performs two attacks, knocking back, stunning and damaging enemies.
419.long_description: Sgt. Knox swings his axe in an arc, knocking nearby enemies back, damaging, and stunning them for 2 seconds. He then leaps at a random enemy and swings his axe in an overhead blow, dealing even more damage and stunning enemies in the area for 5 seconds.
419.name: Break The Line

420.description: Ellywick strums her guitar sending out musical energy to attack up to 3 random enemies.
420.long_description: Ellywick strums her guitar sending out musical energy to attack up to 3 random enemies.
420.name: Quick Strum

421.description: Six feywild creatures run to Ellywick damaging enemies as they come and go.
421.long_description: Ellywick draws six feywild creatures to her; they appear on the right side of the screen and dash towards her across the enemies, dealing damage as they pass by. Once they are gathered, Powerful Following is increased by 200% for 15 seconds and all Champions adjacent to Ellywick are healed for 50% of their max health. After 15 seconds they dash off again to the right, dealing damage to any remaining or newly spawned enemies.
421.name: Call Of The Feywild

436.description: A beam of crackling green shoots towards an enemy, dealing damage.
436.long_description: A beam of crackling green shoots towards an enemy, dealing damage.
436.name: Eldritch Blast

437.description: Prudence opens a gateway to the dark between the stars, damaging and pulling enemies to it.
437.long_description: Prudence opens a gateway to the dark between the stars, a region infested with unknown horrors. An area of blackness and bitter cold appears on the ground slightly in front of the formation. Tentacles erupt out of it, pulling all enemies together.
437.name: Hunger of Hadar

443.description: Corazón attacks a random enemy from the shadows.
443.long_description: Corazón attacks a random enemy from the shadows.
443.name: Shadow Step

444.description: The joyful Damnation fires flaming cannonballs, igniting all current Grease puddles.
444.long_description: Corazón's ship, the Joyful Damnation, fires flaming cannonballs from afar. This bombardment damages all enemies and lights all existing Grease puddles on fire for 30 seconds. Enemies in the flaming Grease puddles are dealt 1/30th of this ultimate's damage per second and take 100% more damage while the puddle is on fire.
444.name: Fiery Bombardment

445.description: Leaps out of the cart and hits the nearest enemy with their shield.
445.name: Chromatic Fanatic - Fighter

446.description: Shoots a random enemy with their bow.
446.name: Chromatic Fanatic - Ranger

447.description: Strums their lute, sending musical notes flying towards a random enemy.
447.name: Chromatic Fanatic - Bard

448.description: Leaps out of the cart and smacks a random enemy with their mace.
448.name: Chromatic Fanatic - Cleric

449.description: Disappears and damages the furthest enemy with their caltrops.
449.name: Chromatic Fanatic - Rogue

450.description: Launches a magic missile at a random enemy.
450.name: Chromatic Fanatic - Wizard

451.description: The NERDS dive into their cart and a random assortment of NERDS leap out to replace them.
451.long_description: The nerds dive into their cart causing it to shake and a random assortment of nerds leap out to replace them. If a specialization is chosen, the front-nerd will always be the nerd picked by the specialization.
451.name: Shake The Box

461.description: Catti-brie shoots the farthest enemy with her bow
461.name: Long Shot

462.description: D'hani attacks a random painted enemy. If no enemies are painted, D'hani attacks the nearest enemy.
462.name: Fists of Fury

463.description: D'hani flings sharpened paint brushes at five random enemies, dealing damage and applying paint.
463.long_description: D'hani pulls a quiver of sharpened paint brushes from her robes and flings them out at five random enemies. They deal damage and apply D'hani's paints to all enemies they hit.
463.name: Flurry of Brushes

465.description: Brig leaps out and smashes a random enemy with his metallic guitar.
465.name: War Lute

466.description: Cranks the hype by 11, damaging and pushing enemies.
466.long_description: Brig performs a killer solo, with flashing lights and musical notes flying everywhere, damaging and pushing enemies back with massive sound power. For the next 30 seconds, Brig's Hype stacks are increased by 11.
466.name: Solo

468.long_description: Xerophon leaps at a random enemy and stabs them with thier dagger.
468.name: Stab

469.description: Xerophon imitates an enemy and buffs all Champions for 60 seconds.
469.long_description: Xerophon picks an enemy from the current adventure and imitates them for 60 seconds. While the imitation lasts, Xerophon does not attack, but increases the damage of all Champions. If the enemy has been seen in the past 15 seconds the damage increase is further buffed.
469.name: Perfect Imitation

470.description: Widdle fires a firebolt from her enormous Blunderbuss, damaging a random enemy.
470.long_description: Widdle fires a firebolt from her enormous Blunderbuss, damaging a random enemy.
470.name: Blunderbolt

471.description: Widdle leaps out and bites a random enemy, dealing damage and healing everyone affected by Vampiric Gaze.
471.long_description: Widdle leaps out and ferociously bites a random enemy, dealing enormous damage. She then leaps back into the formation where her Vampiric Bite heals her and everyone affected by Vampiric Gaze for an amount equal to her own max health.
471.name: Vampiric Bite

472.description: Yorven leaps out at the nearest enemy, pinning it in place and attacking it once a second for 5 seconds.
472.long_description: Yorven leaps out at the nearest enemy, pinning it in place and attacking it once a second for 5 seconds.
472.name: Ferocious Maul

473.description: Yorven Springpaw wild shapes into a powerful shadow mastiff-like creature for 30 seconds.
473.long_description: Yorven Springpaw wild shapes into a shadow mastiff-like creature for 30 seconds. During this time their attack cooldown is reduced by 2.5 seconds, and their damage is increased by 400%.
473.name: Fey Wild Shape

483.description: Viconia slings a stone at a random enemy.
483.long_description: Viconia slings a stone at a random enemy.
483.name: Sling

484.description: Viconia summons darkness that damages all enemies and increases the odds of triggering Animate Dead.
484.long_description: Viconia summons a cloying miasma of cold and greasy darkness that damages all enemies and increases the odds of any enemies killed by it triggering Animate Dead by 50%.
484.name: Unholy Blight

485.description: Rust shoots a random enemy with his pistols.
485.long_description: Rust shoots a random enemy with his pistols. Rust can not lose his shiny gold piece when he attacks with his pistols.
485.name: Bang Bang

486.description: Rust leaps out and stabs a random enemy with his Rapier.
486.long_description: Rust leaps out and stabs a random enemy with his Rapier. He might drop his shiny gold piece while doing this.
486.name: Stabby Stabby

487.description: Rust climbs into a cannon and fires himself at the enemies, dealing damage in a large area.
487.long_description: Rust loads himself into a cannon and fires himself toward the enemies, dealing damage in a large area upon landing. When using his ultimate, Rust has a 40% chance of dropping his shiny gold piece midway through his flight. This chance is reduced by 2.5% for every 4.5 seconds of ultimate cooldown reduction he has.
487.name: Cannonball!

488.description: Vi shoots the closest enemy with her pistol.
488.long_description: Vi shoots the closest enemy with her pistol.
488.name: Pistol

489.description: Vi's Cockatrice starts attacking the nearest enemy. Trigger again to dive bomb the enemies.
489.long_description: The first time the ultimate button is hit, a metal Cockatrice appears next to her and starts dealing ultimate damage to the closest enemy every second for 30 seconds. The second time the ultimate button is hit, the Cockatrice flies to the middle of a swarm of enemies and explodes, dealing 1000% ultimate damage to all enemies in an area attack.
489.name: Arcane Cannon

491.description: Vi waits for a bigger threat before acting.
491.long_description: Vi waits for a bigger threat before acting.
491.name: Bored Now

492.description: Agdon Longscarf uses his scarf as a whip
492.long_description: Agdon Longscarf uses his scarf as a whip
492.name: Whip Scarf

493.description: Giant Toad shoots its tongue at a Champion, transports them to its belly, and eats them
493.long_description: Giant Toad shoots its tongue at a Champion, transports them to its belly, and eats them
493.name: Giant Toad Swallow

496.description: Desmond shoots the closest enemy with his hand crossbow, knocking them back a bit.
496.long_description: Desmond shoots the closest enemy with his hand crossbow, knocking them back a bit.
496.name: Crossbow

497.description: Desmond moves to closest enemy and attacks with both his swords, damaging all enemies in a small area.
497.long_description: Desmond moves to closest enemy and attacks with both his swords, damaging all enemies in a small area.
497.name: Twin Attack

498.description: Desmond attacks the enemy with the most health 3 times in his werewolf form. Buffing Noble Heart.
498.long_description: Desmond transforms into his Werewolf form and leaps at the enemy with the most hit points. He swipes with both claws, then bites them, then returns to formation and back to human form. Noble Heart gets a +300% increase for 30 seconds.
498.name: Unleash the Beast

499.description: Tatyana strikes at the closest enemy with two Kukri strikes.
499.long_description: Tatyana strikes at the closest enemy with two Kukri strikes.
499.name: Twin Kukri Strike

500.description: Tatyana strikes at the closest enemy biting and clawing them.
500.long_description: Tatyana strikes at the closest enemy with a bite and two clawed swings for three hits.
500.name: Primal Savagery

501.description: Entangling roots appear, dealing damage to enemies within while reducing their damage.
501.long_description: A stripe of entangling roots appears to the right of the front column, dealing damage to all enemies inside it, and all enemies that enter it during its duration. Enemies standing in the roots deal 50% less damage. The roots last for 30 seconds.
501.name: Entangle

502.description: Bavlorna attacks with her lilypad legs, dealing damage and attempting to swallow them.
502.long_description: Bavlorna attacks with her lilypad legs, dealing damage and attempting to swallow them.
502.name: Bavlorna Blightstraw Swallow

503.description: Blooshi attacks with an Eldritch Blast dealing damage and taunting it, if possible.
503.long_description: Blooshi attacks the closest untaunted enemy with an Eldritch Blast dealing damage and taunting it. If all enemies are currently taunted, she attacks a random enemy instead.
503.name: Taunting Blast

504.description: Bullywug spirits toss each enemy back, dealing damage to each of them.
504.long_description: Bullywug spirits fly in picking up each enemy and tossing them back 25% of the screen, dealing damage to each of them.
504.name: Spirit Charge

506.description: Gazrick attacks the closest enemy with magic dealing damage with a chance to stun them.
506.long_description: Gazrick attacks the closest enemy with a magic attack that causes one hit and a 50% chance that the enemy is stunned for 2 seconds.
506.name: Frostbite

507.description: Gazrick summons a sleet storm above the nearest enemy dealing damage and freezing the ground in a large AOE radius.
507.long_description: Gazrick summons a sleet storm above the nearest enemy dealing damage and freezing the ground in a large AOE radius. The frozen ground lasts for 30 seconds slowing enemies by 50% while they travel through it. If not already snowing, it begins to snow until the area changes.
507.name: Sleet Storm

509.description: Dungeon Master fires white rays at a random enemy.
509.long_description: Dungeon Master fires 1 or more white rays at a random enemy.
509.name: Magic Missile

510.description: Dungeon Master waves his hands, and the Ultimate ability with the longest remaining cooldown immediately recharges.
510.long_description: Dungeon Master waves his hands, and the Ultimate ability with the longest remaining cooldown immediately recharges. The cooldown for this Ultimate is set to the time the recharged Ultimate had left. Dungeon Master increases the damage of all Champions in the formation for half of the time his Ultimate is cooling down.
510.name: Invigorate

513.description: Nordom simultaneously fires two crossbows at the closest two enemies.
513.long_description: Two gear spirits have taken the form of crossbows, which Nordom fires simultaneously at the closest two enemies. If only one enemy remains, he'll instead hit it twice.
513.name: Gear Spirits

514.description: A multitude of modrons march through pushing back and damaging enemies as they pass by.
514.long_description: A multitude of modrons march from left to right over 15 seconds, pushing all enemies back a short distance and dealing ongoing massive damage as they pass by.
514.name: The Frequent Modron March

518.description: Nordom simultaneously fires two crossbows at the closest two enemies. Piercing Bolts - Causes enemies to take additional damage for 10 seconds.
518.long_description: Two gear spirits have taken the form of crossbows, which Nordom fires simultaneously at the closest two enemies. If only one enemy remains, he'll instead hit it twice. Piercing Bolts -  Causes enemies to take additional damage for 10 seconds.
518.name: Gear Spirits - Piercing Bolts

519.description: Nordom simultaneously fires two crossbows at the closest two enemies. Explosive Bolts - Knocks enemies back.
519.long_description: Two gear spirits have taken the form of crossbows, which Nordom fires simultaneously at the closest two enemies. If only one enemy remains, he'll instead hit it twice. Explosive Bolts - Knocks enemies back.
519.name: Gear Spirits - Explosive Bolts

524.description: Merilwen attacks a random enemy with a magical spray of poison.
524.long_description: Merilwen attacks a random enemy with a magical spray of poison.
524.name: Poison Spray

525.description: Merilwen does not attack while in cat form.
525.long_description: Merilwen does not attack while in cat form.
525.name: Distracting Cuteness

526.description: Stone spikes come out of the ground, enemies take massive damage over time while in the area.
526.long_description: Stone spikes come out of the ground with a 30 second duration. Enemies take massive damage over time while in the area.
526.name: Merilwen's Meat Grinder

527.description: Merilwen attacks a random enemy with a spray of poison, they take BUD damage over time.
527.long_description: Merilwen attacks a random enemy with a magical spray of poison. Stink Like Skunk - Causes enemies to take BUD damage over time.
527.name: Poison Spray

528.description: Nahara attacks a random enemy and every enemy that she already hit with a bolt of energy.
528.long_description: Nahara attacks a random enemy and every enemy that she has already hit with this attack.
528.name: Witch Bolt

529.description: Nahara takes off and channels Azalin Rex, increasing her damage for 15 seconds.
529.long_description: Nahara takes off into the air and channels the power of her patron Azalin Rex for 15 seconds. Her damage is increased by 1,000% while in this form and any enemy she hits has a 50% chance of being stunned for 2 seconds.
529.name: Form of Dread

530.description: Nahara attacks a random enemy and every enemy that she already hit with a bolt of energy, they may be stunned.
530.long_description: Nahara attacks a random enemy and every enemy that she has already hit with this attack. Form of Dread - Provides a 50% chance to stun hit targets for 2 seconds.
530.name: Witch Bolt

538.description: Valentine attacks a random enemy with a mental magic attack, which deals damage and has a chance to stun them.
538.long_description: Valentine attacks a random enemy with a mental magic attack for one hit and enemies have a 50% chance that they are stunned for 2 seconds.
538.name: Mind Sliver

539.description: Valentine targets the nearest enemy and those around it dealing damage and stunning them. While stunned they take additional damage.
539.long_description: Inky black tentacles erupt from Valentine's mouth and hands targeting the closest enemy and those around it dealing damage and stunning them for 4-8 seconds. While stunned they take an additional 1000% damage from all sources.
539.name: Arms of Hadar

540.description: Voronika creates a flame in her hand which she fires at a random enemy.
540.long_description: Voronika creates a flame in her hand which she fires at a random enemy.
540.name: Produce Flame

541.description: Voronika magically damages and pushes back all enemies. Survivors do reduced damage for 30 seconds.
541.long_description: Voronika moves in front of the party, magically damaging and pushing back all enemies. Any surviving enemies do reduced damage for 30 seconds.
541.name: Horrifying Visage

543.description: Voronika attacks a random enemy. The target is lit on fire and takes damage for 5 seconds
543.long_description: Voronika creates a flame in her hand which she fires at a random enemy. The target is lit on fire and takes 1 second of BUD damage every second for 5 seconds.
543.name: Produce Flame - Darklord

544.description: Dob leaps to the closest enemy and attacks with a wave of thunder, knocking them back.
544.long_description: Dob leaps out to the closest enemy and plays a chord on his Lute that sends out a magical blast of thunder and lightning, damaging all enemies in the area and pushing them back a short distance.
544.name: Thunderwave

546.description: Lucius attacks a random enemy with Acid Splash, dealing damage. Prefers enemies not affected by acid.
546.name: Acid Splash

547.description: Lucius attacks the furthest enemy with Ray of Frost, dealing damage to them and all enemies along the line.
547.name: Ray of Frost

548.description: A wall of stone erupts under an enemy. Enemies hit by the wall take damage and are knocked backwards. The wall lasts for 15 seconds.
548.long_description: Dob raises Ethelfrith's hammer into the air and 60 skeletons and one flameskull burst out of the ground. The flameskull oversees the Skeletons build a wall of stone, and any enemies in the area where the wall is being built take ultimate damage and are pushed back by the skeletons behind the wall. The wall lasts for 20 seconds and for that time enemies cannot pass it. While the wall is present, Evil Champions deal +1000% damage for reasons best left unsaid.
548.name: Ethelfrith's Hammer

549.description: Nova leaps out and slices through and slows the nearest enemy with Tiangong.
549.long_description: Nova leaps out and slices through and slows the nearest enemy with Tiangong. If her attack kills the enemy, it drops a monster heart.
549.name: Dissect

550.description: Summoned skeletons build a wall that lasts for 20 seconds. Evil Champions deal extra damage for the duration.
550.long_description: Dob uses the hammer to summon a bunch of skeletons to build a wall that lasts 20 seconds, dealing damage to enemies in the way. For the duration, evil Champions deal +1000% damage for reasons best left unsaid.
550.name: Ethelfrith's Hammer

551.description: Qillek rains purple feathers from above, calming all attacking monsters.
551.long_description: Qillek rains purple feathers from above, calming all attacking monsters and slowing their attack speeds by 200% for the next 30 seconds, and slowing their enrage power-up timer by 200% for the next 60 seconds.
551.name: Calm Emotions

552.description: Nova levitates with Tiangong, releasing three waves of blue energy damaging all enemies.
552.long_description: Nova levitates up in the air as Tiangong floats in front of the formation, releasing three waves of blue energy that deal damage to all enemies. The damage is increased by 1% times to total number of Aerois Synergy stacks.
552.name: Activate Tiangong

553.description: Aila unleashes lightning across all her enemies, damaging and stunning all of them.
553.long_description: Aila unleashes lightning across all enemies, damaging and stunning them for 5 seconds. Deals 10% more damage for each stack of Aerois Synergy.
553.name: Storm Herald

560.description: Egbert throws a bomb at the nearest enemy, dealing damage and knocking back enemies in a small area.
560.name: Homemade Bombs

561.description: Radiant light shines out from behind La Vache Mauve dealing damage to enemies and increasing Champion damage by 1000% for 20 seconds.
561.long_description: Clouds come down from the top of the screen and part, revealing the head of La Vache Mauve. Radiant light shines out from behind La Vache Mauve's head and illuminates the area. Enemies take ultimate damage, and the Champions deal 1000% more damage for 20 seconds.
561.name: La Vache Mauve

562.description: Egbert throws a smoky bomb at the nearest enemy. Dealing damage, knocking back and weakening enemies in a small area.
562.name: Homemade Bombs - Smoky Bombs

563.description: Kent strikes the closest enemy with his rapier.
563.name: Rapier

564.description: For 30 seconds, when Kent attacks, a ghostly spirit attacks an enemy dealing BUD damage.
564.long_description: The weather changes to fog. For 30 seconds, whenever Kent attacks, a ghostly spirit is summoned and attacks an additional enemy if possible dealing BUD damage.
564.name: Wails from the Grave

565.description: Kent strikes the closest enemy with his rapier, a ghostly spirit also attacks.
565.name: Rapier

566.description: Virgil fires 3 magic missiles at random targets.
566.name: Magic Missile

567.description: Virgil fires 3 magic missiles at random targets.
567.name: Magic Missile

568.description: Virgil fires 4 magic missiles at random targets with a chance to stun.
568.name: Magic Missile

569.description: Virgil fires 3 magic missiles at random targets.
569.name: Magic Missile

570.description: Thespian Yorven attacks twice quickly while he has more than half health
570.name: Thespian Yorven Claw 1

571.description: Thespian Yorven attacks four times quickly while he has less than half health
571.name: Thespian Yorven Claw 2

572.description: Virgil attacks a random enemy with lightning, chaining up to 20 times. Weather changes to thunder.
572.long_description: Virgil attacks a random enemy with a bolt of lightning dealing ultimate damage. Every 0.2 seconds, the lightning bolt attacks another random enemy until 20 enemies are struck or no enemies remain. In addition, the area's weather changes to thunder.
572.name: Chain Lightning

574.description: Warduke moves up to the closest enemy and swings his sword, dealing one hit to all nearby enemies with a melee attack.
574.name: Nightwind

575.description: Warduke's sword ignites in flames for 30 seconds. Warduke deals additional damage and takes half damage.
575.long_description: Warduke's sword Nightwind ignites in flames for 30 seconds. For the duration, Warduke deals an additional 1000% damage with his normal attacks and he takes half damage from all sources. If Warduke activates his ultimate again before its effect expires the duration is refreshed.
575.name: Flame Tongue Sword

576.description: Imoen shoots a random enemy with her bow.
576.name: Short Bow

577.description: Imoen attacks five enemies, hitting each 5 times. She prioritizes hits-based enemies.
577.long_description: Imoen leaps out into the fray, attacking five enemies in sequence with her short sword in one hand and her lockpicks in the other. She prioritizes enemies with hits-based health and deals 5 hits per attack; if no hits-based enemies are available she deals normal ultimate damage to enemies she attacks.
577.name: Disarm Traps

578.description: Krydle attacks a random enemy with his daggers. He also sneaks a smokepowder bomb onto their person, which explodes after 3 seconds.
578.long_description: Krydle attacks a random enemy with his daggers. While doing so, he reverse pick-pockets a smokepowder bomb onto their person, which explodes for which deals 3 seconds of BUD damage in a small radius after 3 seconds if the enemy is not killed in the meantime.
578.name: Reverse Pickpocket

579.description: Jaheira attacks the nearest enemy with her scimitar, dealing BUD damage and rooting them and nearby enemies in place with vines.
579.long_description: Jaheira attacks the nearest enemy with her scimitar and then summons roots to hold them in place for 3 seconds. The roots also damage and root other nearby enemies.
579.name: Tangling Scimitar

580.name: Dazing Ray (No Stun, for polymorphed Gazers)

581.description: Nerys cleaves all targets near the closest enemy. Undead enemies take an additional 5 seconds worth of BUD damage.
581.name: Dash and Slash

582.description: Fen darts out to the closest enemy and slashes with her longsword, hitting all nearby enemies.
582.name: Pact Blade

583.description: Fen sprouts wings and charges, dealing damage to all enemies and knocking them back.
583.long_description: Fen transforms into her dread form. She sprouts wings, leaps into the air, and charges directly across the area, dealing one hit of ultimate damage to all enemies she passes and knocking them back a short distance.
583.name: Form of Dread

584.description: Fen darts out to the closest enemy and slashes with her longsword, hitting all nearby enemies. Shadows of the Underdark - Deals an additional 5 seconds of BUD damage.
584.name: Pact Blade

585.description: Uriah points at a random enemy and deals damage, preferring enemies that are already damaged.
585.name: Toll the Dead

586.description: Brother Uriah creates a wall of magical blades that damages enemies for 10 seconds.
586.long_description: Brother Uriah creates a wall of whirling, razor-sharp blades of magical energy and sends them flying across the area. The blades come to a stop a short distance in front of the formation forming a barrier that lasts for 10 seconds. Each time an enemy passes through the barrier, they take ultimate damage.
586.name: Blade Barrier

597.description: Solaak fires an arrow at the closest enemy, knocking it back and dealing damage to it and nearby enemies. Everyone takes 400% more damage for 5 seconds.
597.name: Knockback Strike - Emboldened

598.description: Solaak and Tempest fly over the enemies, while Tempest breaths lightning breath dealing damage, stunning, and knocking the enemies back.
