trials_faq.contents: What are the Trials of Mount Tiamat? The Trials of Mount Tiamat is a co-operative multiplayer campaign that allows you to earn currency used to power up your Champions' equipment items. In it you will take part in an epic battle against the forces of Tiamat, the Mad Dragon Queen, who has recently escaped to Faerun and threatens to destroy the whole of reality. You will battle to distract, disrupt, and destroy the Dragon Queen's forces in conjunction with up to four other players in a last ditch effort to banish Tiamat back to Avernus and save the world. How do I unlock this feature? Before you can take part in the Trials of Mount Tiamat you must have battled Tiamat at the end of the Descent Into Avernus campaign and then completed the introductory adventure by clicking the Trials of Mount Tiamat campaign button on the campaign map. Once that is done, a new dialog will appear in the game which will let you create and join active Trials of Mount Tiamat campaigns. What is a Trials of Mount Tiamat campaign? A Trials of Mount Tiamat campaign is a multiplayer group campaign that lasts for seven days once it has been started. In a campaign, five players must complete five different Trials in order to distract, disrupt, and destroy the Dragon Queen's forces in order to banish Tiamat and save the world. How do I create a Trials of Mount Tiamat campaign? Once you've unlocked the Trials of Mount Tiamat feature you can start a campaign on the main Trials of Mount Tiamat dialog. You do so by picking the campaign difficulty and the currency you will use to start it. Normal campaigns have no cost or requirements to create, but higher difficulty campaigns require you to have defeated Tiamat at the difficulty below it and pay a currency cost in order to start it. Once you have created a campaign, you can select your Trial and nominate your Assault Front Champion. You may then wait for up to four additional players to join and "ready up" before you start it. You do not have to pay the starting currency costs until you start the campaign. How do I join a Trials of Mount Tiamat campaign? Once you've unlocked the Trials of Mount Tiamat feature you can join a campaign on the main Trials of Mount Tiamat dialog. You can view a list of available campaigns started by other players or input a campaign code to join a specific one (someone who started a campaign can give you one that will let you join their campaign). You can filter by the difficulty of the campaign and/or the available Trials. You can only join campaigns at most one difficulty higher than the highest difficulty at which you have defeated Tiamat. Once you have joined a campaign you must pick a Trial to attempt and nominate your Assault Front Champion in order to "ready-up". What are the "Trials" and how do I pick one? The "Trials" of Mount Tiamat are five unique adventures that take place on, around, or under Mount Tiamat, and focus on distracting, disrupting, and destroying the Dragon Queen's forces so that the Assault Front Champions can engage her directly in order to banish her back to Avernus. The five trials are the Forest Trial, the Swamp Trial, the Mountain Trial, the Plains Trial, and the Underground Trial. The monsters and environments you battle in vary from Trial to Trial, and there are rewards for completing each Trial for the first time, but other than that it doesn't make a difference which Trial you choose on any given week. You must pick a Trial before a campaign you create or join can be started. Only one player can pick each Trial each week. What is an "Assault Front Champion" and how do I pick one? Each player who joins a campaign selects one of their roster's Champions to join the Assault Front. The Assault Front is where Champions directly engage Tiamat, taking advantage of the distractions from the players' Trials in order to deal damage over time and attempt to reduce Tiamat's health to zero and force her into the Red Wizard's trap. Players will be unable to use their chosen Assault Front Champion while the campaign is active, however these Champions are not completely disabled. They will provide buffs to all players on the campaign based on their role(s) and their item level, so sending more popular, more powerful Champions to the Assault Front will result in higher buffs to each party. Choose carefully! What can I do during a Trials of Mount Tiamat campaign? The goal of the Trials of Mount Tiamat campaign is to reduce Tiamat's health to zero. To do so, players must increase their DPS contribution by doing their chosen Trial adventure. For specifics of how to increase your DPS contribution, see questions further below. Aside from doing your Trial adventure, you can also use scrolls to increase the damage, gold find, and assault party dps contribution of all players' parties. You can also read Sending Stone messages from the Assault Front Champions as they update the party on the progress of their battle against Tiamat. How is my DPS contribution calculated? DPS done by each player is primarily acquired by completing the area objective in their Trials adventure each day. These DPS contributions stack additively on top of each other and can greatly increase your party's total DPS. Each player also receives additional DPS equal to the exponent of the total damage done by that player's formation on their Trials adventure throughout the week. For example if a player has done 1.0e50 damage in total throughout the week, this contribution will be 50. This DPS contribution stacks additively with the Area Objective contribution. Finally, Scrolls of Assault can be used to increase the DPS contribution of all players in the campaign. How do I increase my DPS contribution? There are three ways to increase your DPS contribution: 1. Complete your daily area goal in your Trials adventure. This can be a big boost to your DPS contribution and you can do this once per day. 2. Deal more total damage in your Trials adventure. Your base DPS number is based on the exponent of the total damage done by your party in your Trials adventure during the campaign week. For example if you've done 1.0e50 damage in total throughout the week, your base DPS number will be 50. The total damage use to calculate your base DPS is cumulative throughout the week. 3. Use Scrolls of Assault. These scrolls can be found in Glory of Bahamut chests and increase the DPS contribution of all players in your campaign. What happens on my Trial Adventure? By battling through your Trial Adventure, you will increase your DPS contribution to the Assault Front party. See the section about how your DPS contribution is calculated for more details. You can reset your Trial Adventure multiple times a day, but will always be forced to reset at the end of the day. This is because each day, the battle against Tiamat gets harder. You start out on day one with a single, simple restriction on the adventure, such as "Only Champions with STR 10+ can be used", but each day a new restriction is added, making the fight to reach your daily area goal even harder. You will earn Bahamut favor by resetting your Trial Adventure, which can be converted to the permanent favor of your choice after the campaign has ended. What rewards can I earn from the Trials of Mount Tiamat? Every time you complete a campaign, based on how much damage you do to Tiamat over the course of the campaign, you receive Scales of Tiamat, which can be used to forge and upgrade Legendary equipment. If you manage to bring Tiamat's health to zero and banish her back to Avernus you will receive a bonus of 50% more Scales. You may also receive 1 or more Glory of Bahamut chests for defeating Tiamat. The higher the difficulty level of the campaign, the more Scales and Chests you can get. There are also some one-time rewards you can receive for defeating Tiamat. The first time you defeat Tiamat on each difficulty, your Scales of Tiamat reward will be multiplied by 3. Additionally, the first time you defeat Tiamat after taking part in each Trial you will receive a special Champion Skin. Note that these one time rewards may change or be renewed over time. My Campaign has ended but I can't claim rewards! Why not? Once a Campaign has ended, each player is given 24 hours to check-in in-case they have offline progress that would aid in the battle against Tiamat. Once all players have checked in, or 24 hours have passed since the campaign ended, all players can claim their rewards, and any additional check-ins by tardy players will not affect the campaign's outcome. Can I start another Campaign while I wait for players from my old one to check in? Yes, you can create or join another campaign immediately after your campaign ends, however you may need to wait to claim the campaign rewards from your old one. You can claim these rewards through buttons on the dialog even after you've started a new campaign. What happens if we defeat Tiamat before the week is over? If you manage to bring Tiamat's health to zero before the week ends you will be able to claim your rewards immediately. No matter what happens, you can not create or join a new campaign until six days have passed since your previous campaign started. Explain to me how Tiamat's health bar works? Tiamat's health bar takes constant damage based on your party's combined DPS. There is also a bonus section that you may notice. This bonus damage is equal to damage that would have happened if your party was doing their maximum damage for the entire day, and is dealt in one big chunk at the end of the day. How is it possible to do enough damage to banish Tiamat? Especially when the Trial Adventures get harder every day, so it's harder and harder to do more damage in the Trials? The key is the bonus DPS you get from reaching your area goal every day. That bonus DPS will be your primary avenue of increasing your campaign's DPS as you get later into the week, so finding a party that can battle through the Trial restrictions to reach the daily area goal should be your main goal each day. How do higher difficulties affect the campaign? Higher difficulties increase both Tiamat's max health and the maximum number of Scales of Tiamat you can earn for damaging and defeating Tiamat. Since you are limited to one campaign per week, your best bet is to fight Tiamat in the highest difficulty you are confident you can defeat her in. Can I leave a campaign part-way through? No, you can not leave a campaign once it has started. If you join a campaign you may leave before the campaign owner starts it, and as a campaign owner you can abandon your campaign any time before you start it, which will cause everyone in the campaign to be removed. How can I help my campaign do better? Aside from increasing your own DPS contribution, you can use scrolls which increase the damage and gold find of all campaign members while on their Trials adventure. The Champion you choose to send to the assault front will also affect the group, as the type of buff they provide is based on the Champions' role and the magnitude of the buff is based on their item level -- the higher the better. Sending your highest geared Champion will help your team deal more damage.

14879.specialization_description: Gromma now increases her own damage based on her buff of the youngest Champion in the formation.

14881.specialization_description: Gromma supplements her abilities with the Entanglement spell, slowing enemies in writhing roots and increasing the effect of her first specialization choice.

14882.name: Melf's Acid Arrow

15028.name: Marshal of the Flaming Fist
15028.tip_text: Duke Ravengard's support abilities grow stronger as you include more heroes that use melee attacks.

15030.name: Critical Teamwork
15030.tip_text: Duke Ravengard's support abilities grow stronger in an area each time a Champion scores a critical hit!

15031.name: Lead The Charge

15032.name: Strength of Baldur's Gate
15032.specialization_description: Ulder shows the other Champions how to strike vulnerable points to deal more damage.

15033.name: Legacy of Ravengard
15033.specialization_description: Ulder supports Wyll, making them a powerful force together.

15037.name: Training Montage
15037.tip_text: Ezmerelda debuffs enemies as she strikes them, causing them to take more damage when attacked by any Champion.

15039.name: Threat Tracking
15039.tip_text: Ezmerelda increases her debuffs as the Champions defeat more undead, her favored foe. Ezmerelda can add additional favored foes with feats.

15041.name: We've Trained For This
15041.specialization_description: Ezmerelda expands her training regiment to concentrate on well-armored foes.

15042.name: Vampire Hunter
15042.specialization_description: Ezmerelda focuses on dispatching her favored foes quickly and efficiently.

15043.name: The Devil You Know
15043.specialization_description: Ezmerelda steels herself in preparation when participating in adventures that Strahd has taken an interest in.

15048.name: Detective's Entourage
15048.tip_text: Umberto increases the damage of Champions in the two columns behind him.

15050.name: Ongoing Investigation
15050.tip_text: Umberto embarks on an ongoing investigation, periodically increasing his buffs to his allies.

15052.name: Law's Alliance
15052.specialization_description: Umberto's sense of duty resonates with the lawfully aligned.

15053.name: Family of Orphans
15053.specialization_description: Umberto's empathy extends to those without ties.

15054.name: Call of the Wardens
15054.specialization_description: Umberto follows the call of the wild.

15055.name: More Bees
15055.specialization_description: Umberto's command over his swarm intensifies, increasing the rate he can send bees towards his enemies.

15056.name: More Clues
15056.specialization_description: Umberto delves deeper into his investigations, empowering his allies during extended endeavors.

15057.name: More Damage
15057.specialization_description: Umberto just focuses on supporting his fellow Champions, ignoring his loyal bees and his important investigations.

15196.name: Inner Circle
15196.tip_text: Aeon increases the damage of adjacent Champions, with the buff increasing for each Champion in the formation eligible for Aeon's current patron target.

15197.name: Uncover Weakness
15197.tip_text: Aeon uncovers the secrets of her enemies, causing them to take more damage from all sources for each secret she has uncovered.

15199.name: Immediate Infiltration
15199.specialization_description: Aeon concentrates on getting information quickly, good for shorter adventures

15200.name: Play the Long Game
15200.specialization_description: Aeon seeks out comprehensive information, best for long adventures

15201.name: Artificer's Arsenal
15201.specialization_description: Aeon improves the damage of her Cane Wand.

15202.name: Spy Network
15202.specialization_description: Aeon expands her inner circle up to include more members.

15203.name: Powerful Patronage
15203.specialization_description: Aeon assists her current Patron on completing patron variant adventures.

15208.name: Hero's Call

15211.name: Incarnation's Class - Barbarian's Resilience
15211.tip_text: Depending on which glitch form you choose, Wren focuses on her dps, tanking, or debuffing abilities.

15212.tip_text: Depending on which glitch form you choose, Wren focuses on her dps, tanking, or debuffing abilities.

15217.name: Glitch Form: Dwarf Monk
15217.specialization_description: Wren remains in her dwarf monk form from Krynn, focusing on directly dealing damage to enemies.

15218.name: Glitch Form: Tabaxi Barbarian
15218.specialization_description: Wren takes on the form of a Tabaxi Barbarian from Toril, focusing on protecting her allies.

15219.name: Glitch Form: Warforged Sorcerer
15219.specialization_description: Wren takes on the form of a Warforged Sorcerer from Eberron, focusing on debuffing her enemies.

15227.name: Powerful Following
15227.tip_text: Ellywick increases the damage of Champions in the column behind her, with further buffs depending on what cards she pulls from her Deck of Many Things!

15229.name: The Deck of Many Things
15229.tip_text: Ellywick pulls a card from her Deck of Many Things for every 25 enemies defeated or after 60 seconds, changing her buffs for each card drawn.

15231.name: For The Fans
15231.specialization_description: Ellywick focuses on supporting her allies by increasing the odds of drawing Knight cards from her Deck of Many Things.

15232.name: Faster Tempo
15232.specialization_description: Ellywick focuses on her Gold Find abilities by increasing the odds of drawing Moon cards from her Deck of Many Things.

15233.name: All That Sparkles
15233.specialization_description: Ellywick focuses on acquiring Gems by increasing the odds of drawing Gem cards from her Deck of Many Things.

15357.name: Hello, Friends
15357.tip_text: Rust increases the damage of all Champions, and those benefits increase for each Gold Find Champion or Oxventurers Guild affiliation member in the formation.

15359.name: One Gold Piece
15359.tip_text: Rust has a chance of finding his One Gold Piece whenever an enemy is defeated which increases his damage buff. By using his ultimate, he'll drop his gold piece and give you another chance to increase his buff even further!

15362.name: Get Rich Quick
15362.specialization_description: Rust's flamboyant nature inspires his friends to also attempt fantastic feats of daring-do.

15363.name: Even More Riches
15363.specialization_description: Rust becomes more obsessed with his one gold piece, increasing the benefits he grants when he gains and loses it.

15364.name: Rust's Fever Dream
15364.specialization_description: Rust's fixation on gold becomes real when it literally starts raining gold each time he is fired out of a cannon.

15444.name: Uni, the Unicorn
15444.tip_text: Bobby's pet unicorn Uni supports all Champions that are next to her.

15446.name: Scales of Tiamat Scavenger
15446.tip_text: Bobby has a chance to uncover Scales of Tiamat with each defeated boss, with a cap that increases every day.

15447.name: Stunning Strength
15447.specialization_description: Bobby impulsively focuses on his damage dealing role by stunning his opponents when he scores critical hits.

15448.name: Group Charge
15448.specialization_description: Bobby bravely focuses on his support role by leading the heroes behind him into the battle.

15449.name: Not So Low
15449.specialization_description: Bobby focuses on Champions who have low total ability scores.

15450.name: Still Growing Up
15450.specialization_description: Bobby works best with other young Champions.

15451.name: Strong Armed
15451.specialization_description: Bobby flexes his muscles with other strong Champions.

15604.name: Sassy
15604.tip_text: Rosie's damage is increased by having Champions in the formation who are younger than she is. Stack that formation!

15605.name: Deflect Missiles
15605.tip_text: Rosie can deflect ranged/magic attacks back at the attacker, increasing her own damage each time she does so!

15609.name: Matriarch
15609.specialization_description: Rosie particularly enjoys grandmothering females younger than herself.

15610.name: Familiar Friends
15610.specialization_description: Rosie has close ties to the assorted Acquisitions Incorporated teams.

15611.name: Grandmother Night
15611.specialization_description: The legend of Grandmother Night is well known in the halfling community.

15619.name: Born Into Evil
15619.tip_text: Kas increases his damage for each Evil Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively.

15622.name: Spawn of Kas
15622.tip_text: When a Champion that isn't Undead is defeated, Kas brings them back as an Undead Vampire Spawn. Undead Champions also heal with every attack.

15623.name: Kas the Bloody Handed
15623.specialization_description: Kas' Evil nature improves the healing abilities of his thralls.

15624.name: Kas the Betrayer
15624.specialization_description: Betraying those in charge is second nature for someone like Kas.

15625.name: Kas the Destroyer
15625.specialization_description: When in doubt, choose the evil path.

15631.name: Calculating Guidance
15631.tip_text: Voronika increases the damage of all Champions in the column in front of her.

15632.name: Search for the Crown
15632.tip_text: Voronika has three quests to complete, and she becomes much stronger when they are complete.

15635.name: Embrace Evil
15635.specialization_description: Voronika surrounds herself with powerful evil Champions to defeat her foes.

15636.name: Hunt The Favored
15636.specialization_description: Voronika allies with powerful hunters to defeat favored foes.

15637.name: Weaken The Fools
15637.specialization_description: Voronika uses Champions that sap the power of her foes to accomplish her quests.

15638.name: Battle Magic
15638.specialization_description: Voronika's puppet gains a Magic element to their attack for some explosive results.

15639.name: Powerful Focus
15639.specialization_description: Voronika's puppet gains more power from those supporting them and drives enemies back.

15640.name: Strike First, Strike Hard
15640.specialization_description: Voronika's puppet attacks faster and deals more damage while surrounded by allies.

15942.name: Noble of Menzoberranzan
15942.tip_text: Minthara buffs Evil Champions, and these abilities improve as more Evil Champions are in the formation.

15944.name: Soul Branding
15944.tip_text: Minthara debuffs enemies she hits, causing them to take more damage from subsequent attacks.

15946.name: House Matron
15946.specialization_description: Minthara calls upon the ancient power of her lineage, extending her influence to encompass those that tread the line between good and evil.

15947.name: True Soul
15947.specialization_description: Minthara draws upon the sinister power of the mind flayer tadpole within her.

15948.name: Soul Destroyer
15948.specialization_description: Minthara harnesses the full potential of her dark magic to inflict even greater suffering on her enemies.

15953.name: Rallying Cry
15953.tip_text: Sergeant Knox buffs the champions behind him, based on the number of positional formation abilities affecting them

15955.name: Squad Leader
15955.tip_text: Sergeant Knox is at his best when paired with Celeste and Makos

15959.name: Impromptu Allies
15959.specialization_description: As Neverwinter's liaison officer, Sergeant Knox trusts Celeste's abilities to convince lone wolf heroes to work well together.

15960.name: For The Greater Good
15960.specialization_description: Despite Makos's dangerous ambition, Sergeant Knox relies on the tiefling's potent abilities to get things done.

15961.name: Shield Wall
15961.specialization_description: Sergeant Knox focuses on protecting his allies.

15962.name: Archdruid of Emerald Grove
15962.tip_text: Halsin buffs good Champions, and these abilities improve as more good Champions are placed in the formation.

15963.name: Call To Action
15963.tip_text: Halsin has a chance to complete area requirements early, advancing the Champions to the next area more rapidly.

15966.name: Harbinger of the Wilds
15966.specialization_description: Halsin channels the primal strength of the natural world, extending his support to embrace those who navigate beyond the struggle between good and evil.

15967.name: Sage of the Transformed
15967.specialization_description: Halsin's research into the tadpole epidemic is of great use to the foes of the Absolute.

15968.name: Protector of the Grove
15968.specialization_description: Halsin increases the strength of his support depending on how strong his call to action is.

16129.name: Cavalier's Code
16129.tip_text: Eric's first specialization choice buffs different areas of the formation, and his Cavalier's Code increases these buffs and gold find as enemies spawn.

16133.name: Corrupted Gem Scavenger
16133.tip_text: Eric has a chance to uncover Corrupted Gems with each defeated boss, with a cap that increases every day.

16134.name: Trait: Cautious
16134.specialization_description: Eric prefers to hang out at the back of the formation due to his cautious nature.

16135.name: Trait: Brave
16135.specialization_description: Eric reluctantly leads from the front, supporting his allies in the place he can best protect them with his shield.

16136.name: Trait: Sarcastic
16136.specialization_description: Eric's sarcastic wit will inevitably lead him into trouble.

16137.name: Unassuming Force
16137.specialization_description: Eric amplifies the hidden potential of those with unassuming abilities.

16138.name: Youthful Valor
16138.specialization_description: Eric thrives alongside Champions who share the vitality of youth.

16139.name: Treasure Hunters
16139.specialization_description: Eric excels alongside Champions who seek both riches and glory.

16146.name: Grumpy
16146.tip_text: Mehen gets more powerful if you meet the positional requirements for his Grumpy ability.

16147.name: Intimidating Presence
16147.tip_text: Some of Mehen's abilities have special effects if Havilar and Farideh are in the formation.

16150.name: Fighting Force
16150.specialization_description: Mehen rallies a fearsome crew of hard-hitting heroes.

16151.name: Father Figure
16151.specialization_description: Mehen supports promising young adventurers, guiding them with the same wisdom that shaped his adopted daughters.

16152.name: Found Family
16152.specialization_description: Mehen embraces his role as a father by welcoming Farideh and Havilar fully into his Dragonborn family.

16516.name: Thri-kreen Telepathy
16516.tip_text: While Kalix is in the front column of any party, your active party's damage is increased, even if Kalix is in a background party!

16518.name: Unorthodox Alliance
16518.tip_text: Kalix buffs Champions not next to him, and these buffs increase based on the number of Champions that are not a Standard species.

16521.name: Strength in Numbers
16521.specialization_description: Kalix aligns himself with one well represented species, making his telepathic bond with his allies even stronger.

16522.name: Creative Camouflage
16522.specialization_description: Kalix improves his camouflage skills, making him a more dangerous threat when he is frequently attacked.

16523.name: One For You, One For Me
16523.specialization_description: Kalix concentrates on his hunting abilities, quickly tracking down his favored foes and making them more vulnerable to damage.
16523.specialization_name: One For You, One For Me

16527.name: Monsters Are People Too!
16527.tip_text: Ishi's damage is increased by having non-humans in the formation. Stack your formation with other species to buff her!

16528.name: Let's Find Some Treasure
16528.tip_text: Ishi increases the party's gold find when she's with lots of non-humans.

16532.name: Friend to the Familiar
16532.specialization_description: Ishi's damage is increased for each Champion in the formation that comes from a traditional heroic template.

16533.name: Friend to the Feared
16533.specialization_description: Ishi's damage is increased for each Champion in the formation that is feared by the old and traditional.

16534.name: Friend to the Exceptional
16534.specialization_description: Ishi's damage is increased for each Champion in the formation that is of a species that is not commonly seen as an adventurer.

16538.name: Kind Heart
16538.tip_text: Sheila's inherently good nature supports other good Champions in the formation.

16540.name: Potion Reagent Scavenger
16540.tip_text: Sheila has a chance to uncover Potion Reagents with each defeated boss, with a cap that increases every day.

16541.name: Meekly Meeting
16541.specialization_description: Sheila teams up with a bunch of underestimated heroes.

16542.name: Youthful Allies
16542.specialization_description: Sheila's youthful friends are a force to be reckoned with.

16543.name: A Rosy Outlook
16543.specialization_description: Sheila's allies prove there's power in solidarity.

16544.name: Frightening Strike
16544.specialization_description: Sheila's attacks frighten her targets, leaving them vulnerable to critical attacks.

16545.name: Enraging Strike
16545.specialization_description: Sheila's attacks anger her opponents, making them take additional damage until they strike back.

16546.name: Confusing Strike
16546.specialization_description: Sheila's attacks confuse her foes, halting their advance for a few seconds and causing them to take additional damage.

16549.name: Volo's Guide to the Sword Coast

16550.name: Volo's Guide to Combat
16550.tip_text: Volo increases the damage of Champions in the two columns in front of him. Place him behind your damage dealers.

16551.name: Volo's Guide to Questing
16551.tip_text: Volo gets more effective based on the number of guide and/or collection quests you've completed. Complete more quests to power him up!

16554.name: Volo's Guide to Spirits and Specters
16554.specialization_description: Volo writes his manuscript on fighting undead while consulting with other Champions hunting their favored foes.
16554.specialization_name: Volo's Guide to Spirits and Specters

16555.name: Volo's Guide to Brain-Eating Tadpoles
16555.specialization_description: Volo carefully studies the formation's Ceremorphosis-infected population, enhancing his own abilities.

16556.name: Volo's Guide to All Things Magical
16556.specialization_description: Volo works with his fellow "wizards" and other magically inclined Champions.
16556.specialization_name: Volo's Guide to All Things Magical

16722.name: In The Shadows
16722.tip_text: Beadle increases the damage of Champions within 2 slots of his position, and provides a small chance to evade attacks.

16724.name: Share The Glory
16724.tip_text: Beadle ensures that most positional formation abilities that affect him also affect Grimm, if he is in the formation.

16727.name: Epic Equipment
16727.specialization_description: Epic artistry inspires epic mischief, and Beadle excels at both.

16728.name: Premium Gear
16728.specialization_description: Why should Beadle settle for a little when he can have a lot?

16729.name: Shiniest Loot
16729.specialization_description: Nothing sparks Beadle's schemes like a little extra shine.

16735.name: Get Buff
16735.tip_text: Each time Grimm strikes, his attacks quicken and his damage intensifies, lasting until he moves to a new area.

16736.name: Break Their Will
16736.tip_text: Grimm's attacks progressively break through more armor or segmented health. His bonuses last until changing areas, or may persist longer if the party advances quickly.

16890.name: Giant Hunter
16890.specialization_description: The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

16891.name: Giant Taunter
16891.specialization_description: The only problem with taunting giants is that they sometimes hear you.

16892.name: Giant Profits
16892.specialization_description: The Giant's Bane Tavern wasn't built on good intentions — it was built on giant treasure.

16896.name: Cleric Clinic
16896.tip_text: Vlithryn increases the damage of Champions in the columns in front of her and heals the most damaged Champion in the formation every second.

16897.name: Pantheon of Blessings
16897.tip_text: Vlithryn's main damage buff is multiplicatively boosted by the number of Global Tier Blessings you have unlocked.

17048.name: Who Else Would Save Them?
17048.specialization_description: Life above the waves can seem calm, but it can be just as harsh.

17049.name: Help the Unfortunate
17049.specialization_description: Ever since she was a hatchling, Vlithryn has dreamed about coming to the surface to help the unfortunate souls that dwell above.

17050.name: Spreading the Word
17050.specialization_description: Vlithryn's faith in Persana is what allows her to make a real impact on the surface.

17053.name: The Long Game
17053.tip_text: Windfall increases the damage of all Champions in the longest column(s).

17055.name: Dragon's Pride
17055.tip_text: Windfall increases the effect of The Long Game for each adventure, variant, and Patron variant you have completed in the Vecna: Eve of Ruin campaign.

17056.name: Red Dragon's Greed
17056.specialization_description: Windfall's attacks take on the aspect of a greedy red dragon.

17057.name: Blue Dragon's Spark
17057.specialization_description: Windfall's attacks take on the aspect of a shocking blue dragon.

17058.name: Green Dragon's Spite
17058.specialization_description: Windfall's attacks take on the aspect of a noxious green dragon.

17059.name: Black Dragon's Corrosion
17059.specialization_description: Windfall's attacks take on the aspect of a vile black dragon.

17060.name: White Dragon's Chill
17060.specialization_description: Windfall's attacks take on the aspect of a chilling white dragon.

17063.name: Rag Tag Team
17063.tip_text: Yorven increases the damage of all Champions for each unique species in the formation.

17065.name: Danger Sense
17065.tip_text: Champions in the formation with Yorven take less damage from attacks, and his main buff is increased when his maximum health increases.

17070.name: Hunger For Blood
17070.specialization_description: Yorven turns his remaining ferocity on additional enemies

17071.name: Eldritch Claw Tattoo
17071.specialization_description: Yorven's tattoo helps him deal additional damage

17072.name: Follow The Mad Rabbit
17072.specialization_description: Yorven's Blood Fury inspires his allies to deal more damage.

17073.name: Infectious Fury
17073.specialization_description: Yorven's attacks enrage his foes, making them more vulnerable each time they attack the formation.

17079.name: Stalwart Encouragement
17079.tip_text: Hank's primary support ability increases the damage of Champions next to him in the formation.

17081.name: Time Gate Piece Scavenger
17081.tip_text: Hank has a chance to uncover Time Gate Pieces with each defeated boss, with a cap that increases every day.

17083.name: Heart of Heroes
17083.specialization_description: Heroism isn't measured by skill, but by courage.

17085.name: Unyielding Unity
17085.specialization_description: Together, even the softest voices can overcome the mightiest foes.

17086.name: Tactical Advantage
17086.specialization_description: Knock them off balance, then strike where it counts.

17087.name: Dragon Slayer
17087.specialization_description: No monster is invincible, not even the five-headed queen.

17237.name: Unsung Alliance
17237.tip_text: Krond increases the damage of all Champions based on the number of Evil Champions. A specialization expands this to include those with high Strength, Constitution, or Intelligence.

17238.name: Survival of the Strongest
17238.specialization_description: Krond's brute force is amplified when allied with warriors of unparalleled might.

17239.name: Survival of the Fittest
17239.specialization_description: Krond thrives when his allies are forged in the crucible of hardship and pain.

17240.name: Survival of the Smartest
17240.specialization_description: In the company of strategic allies, Krond's keen intellect transforms chaos into calculated triumph.

17241.name: Best of the Best
17241.tip_text: Krond further increases his damage bonus based on how high his companions' chosen ability scores are - higher scores provide greater boosts.

17242.name: Eldritch Strike
17242.specialization_description: Krond's arcane skill weakens his foes, making every subsequent blow cut deeper.

17243.name: Power Behind the Throne
17243.specialization_description: Krond guides the party from the shadows, empowering his allies to deal more damage.

17244.name: War Magic
17244.specialization_description: Krond's deadly magic transforms his simple cantrips into explosive magical attacks.

17316.name: Lead The Way
17316.tip_text: Tess increases the damage of Champions behind Tess, and Uggie increases the damage of Champions not next to Uggie.

17320.name: Trap Expert
17320.tip_text: Tess's slain enemies occasionally drop traps, which she disarms for a permanent persistent bonus to her main support ability.

17321.name: The Fallback Plan
17321.specialization_description: When the titans are absent, ordinary souls must bear the weight of responsibility and courage.

17322.name: Eyes on the Horizon
17322.specialization_description: Tess is still learning, but she always looks ahead.

17323.name: Rogues' Gallery
17323.specialization_description: One day, Tess hopes to make it through her mentor's challenge to finally grab that green scarf.

17324.name: Unseen Encouragement
17324.tip_text: K'thriss' unseen servant, Velvet, increases the damage of Champions not adjacent to K'thriss.

17325.name: Hoardsperson
17325.tip_text: K'thriss collects extra coins from defeated enemies and uses them to empower a Shadow Demon that he summons when he uses his Ultimate Ability.

17328.name: Velvet Touch
17328.specialization_description: K'thriss contacts his unseen servant Velvet to increase the damage of Champions that are far from him in the formation.

17329.name: Ligotti's Minions
17329.specialization_description: K'thriss's familiar Ligotti empowers the formation's damage and gold find abilities based on the number of Champions that are part of his favorite Acquisitions Incorporated affiliations.

17330.name: The Unknowable Ur
17330.specialization_description: K'thriss's Patron Ur provides a big increase to his buffs, decreasing as enemies are defeated in the current area.

17472.name: Bargaining Power
17472.tip_text: Baldric increases the damage of his bargaining partners, which start as Fallbacks Champions and those with a high Charisma. More can be added with his specialization choices!

17476.name: Healing Word
17476.tip_text: Baldric heals Champions in all the columns in front of him, and his Healing Lantern empowers all healing abilities when any Champions are heavily damaged.

17479.name: Fury of the Small
17479.tip_text: Lazaapz works best with small species (fairy, gnome, goblin, halfling, kender, kobold and plasmoid). The more the merrier.

17480.name: Power Armor
17480.tip_text: Lazaapz's armor prevents her from taking some damage, and she has a Contingency Plan to repair her armor after it becomes too damaged to continue.

17484.name: Fury of the Brawl
17484.specialization_description: Nothing beats a sharp blade and a sturdy fist. Lazaapz calls for some melee muscle.

17485.name: Fury of the Cabal
17485.specialization_description: A little villainy goes a long way. Lazaapz draws in the morally flexible to form her cabal.

17486.name: Fury of the Stall
17486.specialization_description: Patience is a weapon. Lazaapz brings in the crowd-control crew to lock things down.

17487.name: Guardian
17487.specialization_description: Lazaapz adapts her armor to be a guardian, intending to be in the front line of conflict.

17488.name: Infiltrator
17488.specialization_description: Lazaapz adapts her armor to be an infiltrator, making her excel at more subtle undertakings.

17491.name: Bargain With Tyr
17491.specialization_description: Baldric has a complicated relationship with Tyr, the god of law and justice.

17492.name: Bargain With Moradin
17492.specialization_description: All dwarves are familiar with the strength of Moradin, the main deity of their pantheon.

17673.name: Library of Lore
17673.tip_text: Cazrin collects books that bosses drop, which increases her damage and her library of books persists between resets.

17674.name: Sunny Disposition
17674.tip_text: Cazrin increases the damage of Champions in her column and the columns in front of her.

17678.name: Self Taught
17678.specialization_description: Forbidden by her family to study magic, Cazrin secretly taught herself the arcane arts.

17679.name: Ancestor's Shadow
17679.specialization_description: Cazrin strives to use her magic for good and not follow her ancestor's twisted path.

17680.name: Lost in the Library
17680.specialization_description: Her hunger for knowledge outweighs ambition; Cazrin would rather read than rule.

17681.name: Signature Smell
17681.specialization_description: The worse Uggie smells, the harder Cazrin hits. A disturbing symbiosis.

17682.name: Smell Mastery
17682.specialization_description: It takes true mastery to turn a smell that bad into a support strategy.

17746.name: Circle of Divination
17746.tip_text: Alyndra increases the damage of adjacent Champions.

17748.name: Brows of Judgement
17748.tip_text: Alyndra's owl companion Griff judges enemies as they spawn, increasing the effect of Circle of Divination per judged enemy.

17749.name: Expansive Vision
17749.specialization_description: Alyndra peers into even more futures, increasing the number of Champions receiving Portent.

17750.name: Extra Judgy
17750.specialization_description: Alyndra focuses on Griff, increasing the effect of their judgement.

17751.name: Heroes of the Planes
17751.specialization_description: Alyndra magnifies the abilities of her favorite companions: Avren, Briv, Freely, Orkira, Penelope, and Widdle.

17756.name: Phase One: The Watcher
17756.tip_text: The King of Shadows goes through three phases, and he enters the next phase when he is defeated for the first and second time. His Tanking and DPS abilities improve the longer you can keep him undefeated!

17757.name: Power of the King
17757.tip_text: The King of Shadows increases his own damage and the damage of Champions in the two columns behind him.

17762.name: Master of Pawns
17762.specialization_description: The King of Shadows focuses on supporting his underlings in the formation.

17763.name: Shadow Unleashed
17763.specialization_description: The King of Shadows prioritizes his own abilities to deal massive amounts of damage to his enemies.

17764.name: Legacy of Illefarn
17764.specialization_description: The Guardian was created to defend Illefarn, an ancient elven kingdom that welcomed Dwarves and Humans into its domain. That directive still lingers, though the Guardian has long since been corrupted into the King of Shadows.

17765.name: Embrace the Shadow Weave
17765.specialization_description: The fall of Mystryl shattered the weave, forcing the Guardian of Illefarn to bind himself to the Shadow Weave to survive. In doing so, he became the King of Shadows.

17766.name: Rites of Survival
17766.specialization_description: The King of Shadows will survive by any means necessary, even if it means sacrificing those who stand beside him.

17835.name: Hellish Rebuke
17835.tip_text: Farideh's Hellish Rebuke triggers when enemies hit her or her allies, dealing big damage to the enemy.

17837.name: Pact Family
17837.tip_text: Farideh's damage is increased by the number of tieflings in the formation. Load up your formation with tieflings to really power her up!

17839.name: Daughters of Mehen
17839.specialization_description: Farideh seeks out Mehen and other Dragonborn Champions to assist her in battle.

17840.name: Fury of Asmodeus
17840.specialization_description: Farideh doubles down on her link to Asmodeus, dealing more damage to enemies affected by Hellish Rebuke.

17841.name: Pact with Lorcan
17841.specialization_description: Farideh seeks out the Demons that befuddle her sister, Havilar, and attempts to wipe them from existence.

17845.name: Whispers of Baba Yaga
17845.tip_text: Skylla increases the damage of Champions in the column in front of her, with the benefit increasing as the number of buffed Champions increases.

17846.name: Faerie Fire
17846.tip_text: Skylla casts Faerie Fire on foes she attacks and can't defeat, making them more vulnerable to subsequent attacks.

17848.name: Witch's Switch
17848.specialization_description: The possibilities are nearly endless when you can reshape reality.

17849.name: League of Malevolence
17849.specialization_description: The League of Malevolence is a cabal of odious villains united in one purpose: the accumulation of power.

17850.name: Withering Ward
17850.specialization_description: Skylla draws power from the lifeforce of her opponents.

17851.name: Green Fire
17851.specialization_description: Skylla increases the damage her opponents take when illuminated by her green Faerie Fire.

17852.name: Blue Fire
17852.specialization_description: Skylla's Faerie Fire turns blue, leaving foes vulnerable to critical hits.

17853.name: Violet Fire
17853.specialization_description: Skylla's Faerie Fire turns violet, revealing flaws in the armor of her opponents.

18036.name: Leadership Summit
18036.tip_text: Havilar is a tank who increases the damage of those in the two columns behind her.

18038.name: Mot
18038.tip_text: Havilar travels with two imps: Mot and another chosen by a specialization choice. The imp you choose determines how her Leadership Summit ability is further buffed.

18043.name: Dembo
18043.specialization_description: Havilar chooses Dembo as her second imp, making Mehen just a bit more grumpy.

18044.name: Olla
18044.specialization_description: Havilar chooses Olla as her second imp, buffing her damage as she tanks more enemies.

18045.name: Bosh
18045.specialization_description: Havilar chooses Bosh as her second imp, increasing her health and her damage against enraged enemies.

18051.name: Devil May Care
18051.tip_text: Lark increases the damage of Champions that aren't at the front or back of the formation.

18053.name: Bardic Perspiration
18053.tip_text: Lark can't wait to keep going. He dashes off to the next area before the current one is complete, and spawns a number of enemies by the time the formation catches up to him.

18055.name: Band of Misfits
18055.specialization_description: Lark isn't above using others to his own benefit.

18056.name: Center of Attention
18056.specialization_description: Lark doesn't like to share the spotlight.

18057.name: Path of Nightmares
18057.specialization_description: It's a little too easy to convince Lark to participate in something that is absolutely nefarious.

18058.name: Form Orderly Ranks
18058.tip_text: Nordom buffs all Champions in the column in front of him.

18059.name: Core Programming
18059.tip_text: Nordom increases the bonus of his main buff by methods that depend on the assigned Modron Core, and he also increases the XP earned by that core when a specific specialization is chosen.

18166.name: BASIC Functionality
18166.specialization_description: A curious modron always loves a good Tour of the Forgotten Realms.

18167.name: Modron Core Toolbox
18167.specialization_description: Nordom focuses on increasing the rate your Modron Core gains experience.

18168.name: Core Competency
18168.specialization_description: Once enough time is spent leveling your Modron Cores, Nordom can greatly increase the damage of his allies.

18459.name: Extra Attacks
18459.tip_text: Binwin deals more hits based on how many times those near him attack before he does. He also deals far more damage if he does more hits in one attack.

18463.name: Overkill
18463.specialization_description: Binwin keeps track of how hard he hits, and hits even harder the harder he hits.

18464.name: Dwarven Encouragement
18464.specialization_description: Binwin rallies those adjacent to him to attack more frequently.

18465.name: Tallest in Faerûn
18465.specialization_description: Binwin prefers to hang out with Champions shorter than himself.

18466.name: Crash and Smash
18466.tip_text: Binwin is great at dealing with enemies or objects with hits-based or armor-based health.

18468.name: Unshakable
18468.tip_text: Anson increases the damage of all Champions in the columns behind him, and Uggie increases the damage of Champions not next to her.

18472.name: Combat Trance
18472.tip_text: When Anson gets hurt, his Combat Trance meditation increases, further increasing his Unshakable buff.

18474.name: Pure of Heart
18474.specialization_description: Anson would do anything for his friends.

18475.name: Found Family
18475.specialization_description: As an orphan that grew up in the streets, Anson is always willing to lend a hand to those in need.

18476.name: Never Surrender
18476.specialization_description: Anson's tendency to put himself in harm's way is what Tess loves and fears most about him.

18653.name: Aura of Vitality
18653.tip_text: Donaar heals the most damaged members of your formation, regardless of where they are in relation to him.

18654.name: Lead By Example
18654.tip_text: Donaar buffs Champions in the same column and columns behind him. Place him near the front of your formation to gain the biggest benefit.

18657.name: Not So Straightforward
18657.specialization_description: Sometimes the best path forward isn't a straight line.

18658.name: Scales and Horns
18658.specialization_description: Donaar's tail is an obvious sign of his noble heritage.

18659.name: Business Partners
18659.specialization_description: Donaar invests in his closest friends.

18660.name: Command: Hold
18660.specialization_description: Donaar prefers to command his enemies to hold their movement.

18661.name: Command: Duel
18661.specialization_description: Donaar chooses to enrage his foes into a berserk frenzy by commanding them to duel.

18662.name: Command: Cower
18662.specialization_description: Donaar tends to command his enemies to cower in fear.

18663.name: Command: Droppit
18663.specialization_description: Donaar orders his foes to "droppit", an unorthodox way to get around Command's single word restriction.

18667.name: Radiant Soul
18667.tip_text: Kyre increases the damage of adjacent Champions.

18669.name: Invigorating Radiance
18669.tip_text: Kyre has a chance to stun enemies, and their buff increases each time any Champion attacks a stunned enemy.

18671.name: Complete Control
18671.specialization_description: Kyre is ever calm in the face of danger, trusting in their techniques and those of their allies.

18672.name: Faster Than Light
18672.specialization_description: Kyre fights best with agile allies who can keep pace with their relentless training regiment.

18673.name: Pure of Soul
18673.specialization_description: Kyre's spirit burns with righteous might, inspiring their allies to greater heroics.

18855.name: Story of Doom
18855.tip_text: Deekin tells a story to those adjacent to him, increasing their damage the longer he isn't distracted. Place him next to your highest damage dealers!

18857.name: Boss Wants Speed
18857.tip_text: Deekin increases the speed that enemies spawn when you are killing them quickly. Deekin will make them spawn even faster if you have assigned familiars to attack enemies.

18860.name: Unorthodox Stories
18860.specialization_description: The best tales come from unusual situations.

18861.name: DOOOOOM From Afar
18861.specialization_description: The best storytellers have a lot of range.

18862.name: Troubadour Troupe
18862.specialization_description: Deekin is always willing to learn from the best.

18929.name: Prodigy of High Sorcery
18929.tip_text: Raistlin increases his damage for each Champion that is not next to him.

18930.name: Savant
18930.tip_text: Raistlin's damage is increased for each positional buff he receives that only affects a few other Champions in the formation.

18934.name: Heroic Mage
18934.specialization_description: Heroes are reluctantly forged in the crucible of war.

18935.name: Reclusive Mage
18935.specialization_description: Raistlin stands apart among the Heroes of the Lance as the only true practitioner of High Sorcery.

18936.name: War Mage
18936.specialization_description: When protected by his allies, Raistlin excels at facing the forces of Takhisis.

19237.name: Small Friends
19237.specialization_description: Tas considers the dwarf Flint as his best friend, and while it may seem one-sided, Flint cares for him just as deeply.

19238.name: Fast Friends
19238.specialization_description: Tas approaches everyone with an open heart and is quick to make new friends.

19239.name: Old Friends
19239.specialization_description: Tas is fiercely loyal to his friends, especially his old adventuring companions.

19240.name: Map Collector: Pre-Cataclysm
19240.specialization_description: Some of Tasslehoff's maps date as far back as before the Cataclysm, an event so powerful it reshaped the lands of Krynn.

19241.name: Map Collector: Time of Darkness
19241.specialization_description: Tasslehoff's maps that date after the Cataclysm come from a time when the people believed the gods had abandoned Krynn.

19242.name: Map Collector: War of the Lance
19242.specialization_description: Tas' newest maps were often inspired by his own travels.
19242.specialization_name: Map Collector: War of the Lance

19244.name: Borrower
19244.tip_text: In areas requiring quest items, Tasslehoff will sometimes find a quest item when he attacks.

19245.name: Diversion
19245.tip_text: Tasslehoff prevents non-healing positional formation abilities from buffing his slot and adjacent slots, but his buff grows stronger for each instance this occurs.

19248.name: Arcane Chromat - Acid
19248.tip_text: Lucius deals extra damage to enemies the more times he attacks them with Acid Splash.

19249.name: Arcane Chromat - Cold
19249.tip_text: Lucius deals extra damage to slowed, stunned, and rooted enemies.

19253.name: Dichromancy
19253.specialization_description: Lucius's damage increases in an area the more he can trigger an explosion by combining his favorite two elements.

19254.name: Corrosion Master
19254.specialization_description: Lucius attacks more often with his Acid Splash and it leaves his foes even more vulnerable to additional damage.

19255.name: Lingering Chill
19255.specialization_description: Lucius attacks more frequently with his Ray of Frost and enemies remain minorly slowed even after he has triggered his combo, as well as taking more damage.

effect.description: Increases the effect of Tasslehoff's Map Collector ability by $(amount)%

19336.name: Melf's Custom Support Spell
19336.tip_text: Melf creates a customized support spell to buff adjacent Champions, and it is augmented based on the specializations you pick and his position in the formation.

19339.name: Melf's Frequent Foes
19339.specialization_description: Melf causes more foes to spawn, and those foes will be Favored Foes if possible.
19339.tip_text: Melf has chosen to increase the number of foes spawning, and they will be favored foes if possible.

19340.name: Melf's Speedy Spawns
19340.specialization_description: Melf causes foes to spawn faster and is more likely to deem them as "evil".
19340.tip_text: Melf has chosen to make foes spawn faster and be more likely to deem them as "evil".

19341.name: Melf's Doubled Drops
19341.specialization_description: Melf magically increases the quest rewards of defeated enemies.
19341.tip_text: Melf causes faster quest progress to happen when defeating enemies.

19342.name: Melf's Abundant Allies
19342.specialization_description: Melf's main buff increases based on the most populous species in his formation.

19343.name: Melf's Adaptive Attacks
19343.specialization_description: Melf's main buff increases depending on the number of the most represented attack type of other Champions: melee, ranged, or magic.

19344.name: Melf's Ranked Roles
19344.specialization_description: Melf's main buff increases depending on the number of other Champions with the most represented non-Support role in the formation.

19345.name: Melf's Amorphous Alignment
19345.specialization_description: Melf's main buff increases depending on the number of other Champions with the most represented alignment on the law/chaos axis in the formation.

effect.description: Increases the effect of Laurana's Battle Plan Specializations by $(amount)%

19350.name: Golden General
19350.tip_text: Laurana's Battle Plan affects one of the three columns behind her (your choice); this buff is greatly increased by her Campaign stacks, which you can increase by completing her extra achievements.

19351.name: Leader of the Whitestone Armies
19351.tip_text: Laurana recruits some of her fellow Champions to be Soldiers, and greatly increases the effect of her Battle Plan based on the strength of her Army.

19354.name: Battle Plan: Charge
19354.specialization_description: Laurana orders a direct advance with her closest allies.

19355.name: Battle Plan: Outflank
19355.specialization_description: Laurana attacks from unexpected angles to shatter enemy lines.

19356.name: Battle Plan: Fortify
19356.specialization_description: Laurana reinforces the back, ensuring a devastating attack when the moment is right.

19357.name: Lead the Attack
19357.specialization_description: Laurana's keen tactics grants her Soldiers the ability to critically hit more often and more effectively.

19358.name: Protect the Vulnerable
19358.specialization_description: Laurana increases her fortitude and recruits Soldiers that others may overlook.

19359.name: Wield the Dragonlance
19359.specialization_description: Laurana seeks to destroy every Dragon enemy she can find and recruits other Hunters to join her as her Soldiers.

19675.name: Doomed in Darkon
19675.tip_text: Brother Uriah increases the damage of Champons in his column and the column behind.

19676.name: Ezra's Embrace
19676.tip_text: Brother Uriah heals all Champions within 2 slots of him.

19678.name: In the Grip of Azalin Rex

19680.name: Book of Exalted Deeds
19680.specialization_description: Brother Uriah fights his evil connection, helping champions defeat the Undead and Fiends.

19681.name: Book of Vile Darkness
19681.specialization_description: Brother Uriah embraces his evil connection, helping evil champions deal even more damage.

19686.name: Dancing Lights
19686.tip_text: Trixie's Dancing Lights increases the damage of adjacent Champions.

19687.name: Small Pranks
19687.tip_text: Trixie increases her main buff for each Small Champion in the formation, like halflings and gnomes. Additionally, she shrinks the two Champions behind her in the formation to also count as small!

19692.name: Faster, Friends
19692.specialization_description: Trixie directs the familiars to help the other Champions attack more often.

19693.name: Ultimate Friends
19693.specialization_description: Trixie commands the familiars to boost the damage and speed of your formation's Ultimate attacks.

19695.name: Hunting Strahd
19695.tip_text: Van Richten increases the damage of Champions in the column in front of him, and this buff increases in strength as undead foes are defeated.

19699.name: Watched by Erasmus
19699.tip_text: Van Richten's ghostly son Erasmus watches over him, and he arrives to increase damage against enemies when his father is in trouble.

19700.name: Occult Allies
19700.specialization_description: Van Richten works with other spellcasters to defeat evil.

19701.name: Scholar of Dread
19701.specialization_description: The famous author draws upon the knowledge of others in his quest to eliminate harmful undead from the world.

19702.name: Endless Hunt
19702.specialization_description: Rudolph associates with other hunters and individuals that know how to exploit an enemy's weakness.

19703.name: Occult Aid: Cure Wounds
19703.specialization_description: Van Richten uses his divine gifts to heal other Champions.

19704.name: Occult Aid: Dispel Evil
19704.specialization_description: Van Richten exiles his foul enemies to the shadowfell or another foul home.

19705.name: Occult Aid: Sanctuary
19705.specialization_description: Van Richten protects his allies from attack.

19707.name: Documancer
19707.tip_text: Walnut increases the damage of some Champions in the formation for each enemy killed.

19709.name: Wolfnut
19709.tip_text: Walnut shapeshifts into a wolf when she is under attack, gaining a shield and becoming tankier.

19712.name: Extended Warranty
19712.specialization_description: Documancer reaches further into the formation, opening up more positioning options.

19713.name: Sign and Date
19713.specialization_description: Documancer applies to fixed slots in the formation, opening up even more positioning options.

19714.name: Ah, Screw It
19714.specialization_description: Documancer applies to the entire formation, because positioning restrictions are for chumps.

19715.name: Co-Signers
19715.specialization_description: Documancer is buffed based on synergies with other "C" Team members.

19716.name: Temporary Alliance
19716.specialization_description: Documancer is buffed based on the presence of Champions from other (less famous) teams.

19719.name: Who Am I?
19719.tip_text: Nahara does more damage for every adventure area she completes over all time.

19720.name: To Amuse or Avenge
19720.tip_text: Nahara allows champions to complete future areas more quickly when she is easily defeating enemies, and when she is not she starts to deal more damage.

19723.name: A Grave Experience
19723.specialization_description: Nahara focuses on her experience to deal more damage

19724.name: A Barovian Bond
19724.specialization_description: Nahara focuses on her companions to bring the fight to Strahd

19725.name: A Skilled Lyre
19725.specialization_description: Nahara focuses on her amusement to move more quickly

19730.name: Justice Needs Champions
19730.tip_text: Strongheart buffs the damage of adjacent Champions!

19733.name: Valor's Call
19733.specialization_description: Strongheart is heartened by Good Champions in the formation.

19734.name: Honorary Member
19734.specialization_description: Strongheart joins the largest bonded group in your formation.

19738.name: A Righteous Event
19738.specialization_description: Strongheart is encouraged by a party that actively participates in important gatherings.

19739.name: Event Token Scavenger
19739.tip_text: Strongheart has a chance to discover Event Tokens with each defeated boss, with a cap that increases every day.
